notes.title: The Fate of the Empire
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459272/4858c75212429e70c7bb4a6854408bc6951b8ed0.jpg[/img]

[i]Sanctum system[/i]

The capital of the New Empire was not as beautiful as Earth, covered by a myriad of city lights in the years before the Invasion, but it was rapidly approaching the same splendor. Sanctum’s greatest pride, however, was the system of orbital defense stations and dozens of shipyards that had been created over the years to replace the ships lost in the Invasion. A system of powering the shields from the orbital stations was developed for the safety of the fleet within the system. At first, the Consul was considered paranoid for this precautionary measure, but when a destroyer accompanied by crystallid hunters entered the system during the second Invasion, the defense system of the new capital showed itself in all its glory: the Alien was destroyed in a few minutes, even before the fleet arrived, and not a single civilian ship was seriously damaged. The shield support system worked perfectly.

The Consul’s personal ship hovered near the planet’s equator in a stationary orbit, in the heart of the defense system. There, the Senate was preparing to decide the fate of the divided Empire. The leaders of the Northern Empire and Sparta had already arrived in the Sanctum system: Generals Kodrat Verner and Thomas Alderi, as well as representatives of the Holy Empire and the Steel Legion. Alfred Warren rejected the offer of negotiations as usual. The only one still awaited for the negotiations to begin was General Ironside. The Consul opened a channel of communication with the ship’s captain to check on the preparations for the negotiations.

“Ironside’s first ships are about to arrive, your honor.”
“Very well. I hope this time you won’t make any mistakes and won’t let anyone from his convoy launch fireworks with spy bots?”
“Of course not, your honor! We took all the precautionary measures. Moreover, Ironside will leave hyperspace in a specified location this time. A corridor of ships is already in position. The beacon for his convoy is already set, too. We’re simply waiting for their arrival.”
“We have a lot to discuss today. And check the ship’s emergency systems, just in case. I wouldn’t want any surprises.”

The Seeress class scout ships were the first to arrive to the system, followed by the Scylla and Dragon frigates. At a certain moment, something happened that no one from the Empire could have expected: Jericho frigates from the Patriarch series appeared among the arriving Ironside escort.
The captain of the Consul’s ship demanded a response from them.

“Jericho vessels, identify yourselves.”
“We are Emperor Ironside’s guards. Transmitting codes.”
“Alright. Codes are in order.”

As the ships took their positions in a semicircle, Ironside’s cruiser arrived into the system.

“This is General Ironside. Requesting permission to dock with the Consul’s ship.”
“Permission granted, docking bay 8 is ready for you. It’s the one closest to you.”

As the docking airlock opened, Ironside’s ship immediately went through the corridor, followed by Jericho escort. It was hard for the Legion soldiers to stay nonchalant, but their discipline was stronger than surprise. When the General entered the Senate chamber, he did not follow standard diplomatic procedures and got straight to the point:

“Good afternoon, honored Senate and rulers of the Empire. I would like to introduce you to one of our former enemies, an oracle of Bartle. His presence at this meeting is of utmost importance. I will now make my proposal and justify its necessity.
I have become aware of previously unknown Precursor artifacts that have appeared in the Frontier systems. With the help of the Oracle, I was able to figure out the purpose of the artifacts, and my independent research departments later verified the assumption. These “columns” are the navigational beacons of the Precursors. Their activation indicates the imminent arrival of the former masters of the galaxy, who have been hiding in a far corner of the universe until now. Their strength and numbers are unknown to us. Only one thing is certain: they are the creators of the Bions. At the moment, we are not sure whether they control the Bions now or they will be able to take them under their control after they return. Their arrival is months, weeks, perhaps days away. The location of their return is roughly determined by beacon routing calculations. I will now display it on the screen”

“But there is nothing there, except... That place... Intelligence fleets of all nations have scoured that Alien-infested place repeatedly, but could not even conceive of its purpose,” said the Consul.
“Yes, that is correct,” replied the Emperor, “Intelligence fleets of all nations have been there. It was there that thousands of people searched for the truth almost as fiercely as they did in Sector 1337. But they have not found it. Oracle, I give you the floor, tell us what you know about the arrival of the Precursors.”

The Jericho man raised his head and began to speak in a mechanical voice:

“The Precursors use a technology similar to subspace pockets for hiding and travelling. Alien portals work on a similar principle. So, after a while, the Precursor portal can be opened either by itself or with the help of the Sleeper. Isn’t that what she was awakened for?”

The representative of the Inquisition turned pale and muttered:

“We did not know that the Sleeper’s true purpose was known to anyone. But no, she made her way on her own with the help of the crew of the ‘Scotland’ dreadnought.”
“And that led to the first Invasion, I know,” continued the Oracle. “So, the portal can be opened. It will allow the Precursor fleet to arrive to our galaxy. Perhaps, they can enter in several places at once. Now, there is something to be said for what has been learned about the Precursors during the events in Sector 1337. Their defenses don’t have much range, so their fleet will be vulnerable in a system they haven’t prepared in advance.”
“Wait, you want to fight the Precursors?” the Consul asked. “Wouldn’t Jericho have to be an ally to them?”
“Of course not,” replied the Oracle. “What alliance can there be with the creators of the Bions? What alliance can there be with Gods who deceive their followers? Back to our targets; their fleet will be vulnerable. It’s incredibly strong, but the number of ships in it is not that great. They’ll probably try to get the biomorphs and crystallids on their side if they have to fight.”
“Thank you, Oracle. Let us now turn to our plan,” Ironside said. “Deny them the opportunity to get reinforcements. Tie up the Alien forces with a large fleet of combat troops. Set up a blockade of the system. Attack the Precursors with elite units as soon as they are left with no reinforcements.”
“So you are proposing to engage in a full-scale war with the Aliens and the Precursors?” asked the Consul. “That is the kind of suggestion I would accept from our Emperor, but not from a general.”
“Respectable Consul of the Senate of the New Empire, I am pleased to hear these words. I have with me here an order from the Emperor, properly formalized. You wouldn’t mind if your ship sent a communications request to the Imperial flagship, would you? Besides, our forces will be supported by the Raid and the Families of Jericho, such is Bartle’s word.”
“Captain, requesting communications with the Imperial flagship. Establish a communications channel.”
“Yes, Consul. Trying to contact the Emperor. Unbelievable... The connection is there. The Emperor is ready to speak with you.”

The Senate chamber fell silent. Everyone waited for the words of the man thought dead or on the run.

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459272/c6fd70d6008aa5b8cd0b92dfb91252c97a61c5f0.jpg[/img]

The Multi-Purpose Repair Ship, aka MPRS “Hellas”, was designed by engineers of the Free Worlds of Eridan to replace the obsolete Raptor-type engineering frigates. 
The Free Worlds were unable to afford to purchase new Armada frigates, and so their engineers sought alternative ways to solve the problem. 

Named after the destroyed capital city, the MPRS “Hellas” is an adaptation of the New Empire’s experience with the “Bark-2”. The original blueprints for the modified hull used during the First War for the Bartle Sector were discovered on one of the abandoned Direktorium bases during a scientific expedition. Grasping the opportunity, the engineers of the Worlds of Eridan set to work.

The planetary bomber was heavily modified to meet military requirements. The first tests in 4624 proved the success of the scientists, and soon the MPRS “Hellas” began entering service in small batches. 

In 4625, the UMC analysts noticed the potential of the ship. Initially, the center’s leadership wanted to order a large batch of ships for internal use, but it became clear that the remaining shipyards of the Free Worlds of Eridan had no capacity to fulfill the order and the contract was renegotiated. Currently, the UMC has the exclusive right to produce MPRS “Hellas” ships, and every mercenary of the center has the opportunity to order one.

[hr][/hr]
An excerpt from a leaked internal UMC report:

[quote]Long before the Yith'Mor project was finalized, Ellydium had begun developing a guard frigate. As early as 4620 and 4621, there were small leaks of information about the corporation's desire to develop a ship with a new role. The main difficulty in creating the ship later named “Drag'Thir” was that it was almost impossible to use standard Ellydium crystal nodes. 

More complex elements were required. The needed parts were removed from living Crystallids only in 4624 for the first time. Information about the Ellydium’s study of these samples was passed on to the UMC and “The Frontier Voice” news agency by a source that remains unknown. Rumor has it that Natasha Cortés herself soon gave a good talking to the informant, making them realize the full extent of their mistakes.

Conrad Dimeni was able to convince the board of directors to use this as part of a promotional campaign for the new frigate. Shortly before the first “Drag'Thir” frigates rolled off the slipway, Ellydium issued a promotional publication about the creation of the new ship. One of the brochures, later withdrawn, indicated that the Leviathan power transfer technology was used in the creation of “Drag'Thir”. Some of the ship’s pilots noticed a suspicious similarity between some of the frigate’s elements and Liu Virus infected ships, but the Ellydium explicitly denied these rumors. 

The ship has performed admirably in combat. We will soon be expanding the procurement of “Drag'Thir” for our mercenaries. Nevertheless, there is a proposal to investigate the reasons for the disappearance of “The Frontier Voice” journalist at Pilgrim-11 and the possible involvement of the Ellydium corporation. We need to find out if the unregistered capabilities previously observed in “Waz'Got” are present in this ship as well.[/quote]

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459272/fb69358b870ff92e914a9bef8a40694916c19bdb.jpg[/img]

Pilots! We continue to share the latest features that will appear on the game servers in the upcoming updates. Among them are new modes, events, and of course, ships!

[h1]New event "UMC Archives: Chronicles of the last days"[/h1]

Soon, the next “UMC Archives” event will become available to all pilots. It will include a special battle pass, consisting of only one stage and lasting approximately one month. The event itself will run in parallel with the main battle pass “Allies and rivals” and will end in the beginning of June.

All pilots who complete the “UMC Archives: Chronicles of the last days” event will be able to get a new unique rank 16 engineering frigate MPRS “Hellas”, as well as the modules and weapons of this ship. And those who buy pass packs will get additional bundles of resources, seed-chips and ammunition. You will be able to find them in most of the battle pass levels. We will share more details about the contents of the levels with you during the start of the event. The offer is limited in time and will be available until June 5.

[h1]New ship MPRS “Hellas”[/h1]

In the beginning of May, all pilots will have access to the unique engineering frigate MPRS “Hellas”.

[quote]The Multi-Purpose Repair Ship, aka MPRS “Hellas”, was designed by engineers of the Free Worlds of Eridan to replace the obsolete Raptor-type engineering frigates. The Free Worlds were unable to afford to purchase new Armada frigates, and so their engineers sought alternative ways to solve the problem. 

Named after the destroyed capital city, the MPRS “Hellas” is an adaptation of the New Empire’s experience with the “Bark-2”. The original blueprints for the modified hull used during the First War for the Bartle Sector were discovered on one of the abandoned Direktorium bases during a scientific expedition. Grasping the opportunity, the engineers of the Worlds of Eridan set to work.

The planetary bomber was heavily modified to meet military requirements. The first tests in 4624 proved the success of the scientists, and soon the MPRS “Hellas” began entering service in small batches. 

In 4625, the UMC analysts noticed the potential of the ship. Initially, the center’s leadership wanted to order a large batch of ships for internal use, but it became clear that the remaining shipyards of the Free Worlds of Eridan had no capacity to fulfill the order and the contract was renegotiated. Currently, the UMC has the exclusive right to produce MPRS “Hellas” ships, and every mercenary of the center has the opportunity to order one.[/quote]

notes.title: Developer blog. Entry 119. New open world adventure raid
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459272/af6304d144db63059d547fa9edaa3c9804a1a06e.jpg[/img]

Greetings, pilots! The latest update includes a new adventure raid, the long-awaited event in the open world! We’ve spent a lot of time and resources on creating it and are happy to finally share it with you. In this blog entry, we’ll talk a little bit about it and its importance for the game and the lore of the world of Star Conflict.
[hr][/hr]
Let’s start with the latter. The game’s narrative has recently been developing only outside of the game itself, through various stories and series of stories published on the website. These lore tales have all been building towards the events that you will discover within the game.

The new adventure plunges you into one of the most important and probably the decisive events for humanity in the Frontier sectors. The threat that appeared here has the potential to become devastating, and people will have to overcome their differences and work together to oppose it. While the states redirect all their armies and look for diplomatic ways of increasing humanity's defences, the UMC issues a call for help to every pilot capable of steering a spaceship. There may be no way back.

The adventure presents a challenge for the player, whether through various puzzles that test your logic and knowledge, or through combat that requires skill, fast reaction and ability to pilot your ship masterfully. We believe that adventures should not feel mandatory, they should invite you to solve various problems. The adventure that we have prepared for you combines a variety of challenges that we hope you will be interested in overcoming, and their complexity will not leave you bored.

Your journey will begin with a new “agent” contacting you with a series of assignments. It’s up to you to figure out who this agent is and what their true goals are. Of course, there will also be some familiar faces among the characters you’re going to meet, who will also keep in touch with you.

The adventure will send you on a journey to all corners of the Frontier sectors, where you will perform various tasks. Among the interesting challenges awaiting you are some that will require your ship to have good speed and maneuvering properties. We really hope you will enjoy it!

The adventure will test not only your firepower or your ability to adapt to difficult environments, but also your knowledge of the game’s universe! We recommend you to familiarize yourself with the latest series of stories, as well as with the general lore before you start playing. However, no one is going to rush you, so you don’t need to memorize everything about the world of the game in a short period of time. Just be warned that you may need to search for information in the texts published on the project’s website.

The adventure will make the open world dangerous again. An anomaly has swept through all of the Frontier sectors, causing a massive failure of the Seed-chips. This has happened before, but it seems that this time it will not be possible to restore the chips as quickly. Fortunately, there is a way around: special ammunition will help you deal with threats more effectively. Use it wisely! We hope that in the course of the adventure, the open world will once again become a dangerous place where you need to be on guard and beware of threats that are beyond your ship’s capabilities; in other words, it will once again present a worthy challenge to players.

You will not be able to complete the entire adventure in one fell swoop. On the contrary, the events will unfold at a relatively leisurely pace, and some quests may take more than a day to appear. This way, we hope that you will not get frustrated with having to spend long periods of time in the open world and only go there to complete a new challenge when you feel like you’re ready.

Of course, what’s an adventure without a good reward? We have selected prizes that will hopefully make you feel satisfied by completing the challenges. There may not be a promise of hundreds of millions of credits, but there are definitely valuable things to get: for example, various rare parts that are not usually found among quest rewards. We really hope that part of the reward for completing the adventure will be the experience itself!
[hr][/hr]
There are many things that we haven’t revealed, but we hope that this blog entry will encourage you to check out the open world adventure and immerse yourself in the game’s story development by trying out the challenges we’ve prepared for you. Thank you for your attention and we look forward to seeing you in Star Conflict!

[hr][/hr][h1]Rank 5–15 Ellydium guard frigate “Drag'Thir”[/h1]

[previewyoutube=Xl0BIq_UTKg;full][/previewyoutube]

An excerpt from a leaked internal UMC report:

[quote]Long before the Yith'Mor project was finalized, Ellydium had begun developing a guard frigate. As early as 4620 and 4621, there were small leaks of information about the corporation's desire to develop a ship with a new role. The main difficulty in creating the ship later named “Drag'Thir” was that it was almost impossible to use standard Ellydium crystal nodes. 

More complex elements were required. The needed parts were removed from living Crystallids only in 4624 for the first time. Information about the Ellydium’s study of these samples was passed on to the UMC and “The Frontier Voice” news agency by a source that remains unknown. Rumor has it that Natasha Cortés herself soon gave a good talking to the informant, making them realize the full extent of their mistakes.

Conrad Dimeni was able to convince the board of directors to use this as part of a promotional campaign for the new frigate. Shortly before the first “Drag'Thir” frigates rolled off the slipway, Ellydium issued a promotional publication about the creation of the new ship. One of the brochures, later withdrawn, indicated that the Leviathan power transfer technology was used in the creation of “Drag'Thir”. Some of the ship’s pilots noticed a suspicious similarity between some of the frigate’s elements and Liu Virus infected ships, but the Ellydium explicitly denied these rumors. 

The ship has performed admirably in combat. We will soon be expanding the procurement of “Drag'Thir” for our mercenaries. Nevertheless, there is a proposal to investigate the reasons for the disappearance of “The Frontier Voice” journalist at Pilgrim-11 and the possible involvement of the Ellydium corporation. We need to find out if the unregistered capabilities previously observed in “Waz'Got” are present in this ship as well.[/quote]

notes.title: Special issue of “The Frontier Voice” news publication
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459272/40958adb915130568b43517488faf5559dab8c86.jpg[/img]

[i]Ontregos system[/i]

Greetings, dear viewers and listeners! Welcome to “The Frontier Voice”, this is Max “The Comet” speaking. In today’s issue:
[list]
[*] The Frontier is isolated: the way from the Frontier sectors to the centrer of the galaxy is almost completely blocked.
[*] Full alert: states put their armies on high alert.
[*] Empire and Jericho alliance: a joke or the truth?
[*] “Defiant” is back in service: the ship has completed its repairs in the Vior system.
[*] The intensity of the Signal increases dramatically: scientists are alarmed.
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
So, today we have some shocking news. All known Imperial paths to the metropolis are completely closed to private citizens by decrees of the states. The Federation is also taking full control of the transit hubs. Navigation codes have been changed, it is no longer possible to get to the central regions of the states. The states comment that this is a “temporary security measure to stop the spread of a new form of the Liu-virus”.

The New Empire, Ironside Empire, Sacred Empire, Northern Empire, Sparta, most of the Federation regions, the Mendes Family, and the Custodians have put their armies on high alert. Fleets of ships are arriving to the Frontier sectors. The factions’ heavy fleets are also rumored to be on the move. From the information available, we may be seeing residual movement, and states have managed to discreetly move hundreds of thousands of ships as recently as a few months ago. The purpose of the actions is unclear at this point, but such scale of the movements was not even reached during the Invasion.

The Ironside Empire News Service has published a document saying that peace has been made between the Emperor and Bartle. It is currently impossible to verify this information, but the News Service assures that it is not a hoax. If this is indeed true, then who is their common enemy? The Federation? Aliens? In addition, the fact that the Emperor and Bartle were reported missing or dead leaves many questions about this statement.

The Ellydium corporation announced the completion of maintenance of the dreadnought “Daring” in the Vior system. Immediately after the repairs were finished, the ship headed out on a research mission. Construction of a new dreadnought has started at the Pilgrim-11 shipyard, its name to be announced later.

The intensity of the Signal in the entire observed galaxy has increased many times over, reaching a near-record high. The Signal’s strength continues to grow, and scientists from all nations are demanding this fact not to be ignored. Governments say that crisis management groups have already been set up to deal with the situation.

What’s in store for us? A new Invasion? A war between states? Time will tell, but for now we ask our viewers and listeners to exercise extra caution and stay tuned. Max “The Comet”, signing off.

notes.title: Special issue of “The Frontier Voice” news publication
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459272/1182f54f85a9c7f1dcf73ac777805a119ca509cb.jpg[/img]

[i]Line system,
“Ellydium Theta” station[/i]

Greetings, dear viewers and listeners! Welcome to “The Frontier Voice”, this is Max “The Comet” speaking to you from the “Ellydium Theta” station. The topic of today’s issue is the Drag’Thir cover frigate recently developed by Ellydium. But first, I would like to apologize for the confusing situation with the last issue of our investigation. It turns out the pirates had set up another ambush. They jammed my communications channels, took out the ship’s antennas with a precision shot, and began shutting down the gate. I managed to get through, but it was at the moment of the jump that the gate was shut down. As a result, I was stranded in inter-system space, unable to communicate. I apologize for any possible inconvenience, but now let’s get back to the subject of this issue.

I managed to get a comment from the Ellydium engineers about the new ship, but they insisted that I don’t record the conversation. Now, the cover frigate Drag’Thir is a new Ellydium project. According to our sources, unlike past Ellydium ships, Drag’Thir utilizes fully functioning crystallid nodes. Normally, Ellydium limits these nodes from utilizing most of their capabilities for security purposes. New research into the behavior of crystallids in the Solaris system has allowed the corporation’s engineers to create mechanisms that allow for the safe operation of the nodes’ full functionality. Moreover, the ship is more secure in terms of crystallid node behavior than past models.

Like all Ellydium creations, it has a set of weapons, active and special modules, and a combination of interchangeable nodes. Engineers emphasized the development of the various fields surrounding the ship. The modules are interesting: the ship can create barriers that lock down enemies, mask allies with a beam and even... distort the flow of time around the ship. Moreover, the advanced friend-or-foe identification system allows allies to pass through the locking field and not be affected by the time distortion. No information has been revealed about the ships’ weapons yet, but I was shown the design of one of them. It was probably a launcher for some kind of missiles. For more details, we should wait for the official announcement from Ellydium...
[hr][/hr]
“This is Ellydium Theta station Security Chief Natasha Cortés speaking. You’re being held on suspicion of espionage until the circumstances are clarified. Goddamn it, who let a suspicious journalist slip through the cracks again? And yes, shut down his comms before he divulges all the corporation’s secrets!”

[Connection lost]

[h2]The following ships are available to pilots:[/h2]

[hr][/hr][h1]Rank 5–15 Ellydium guard frigate “Drag'Thir”[/h1]

[previewyoutube=i3iq5hR-S2k;full][/previewyoutube]

An excerpt from a leaked internal UMC report:

[quote]Long before the Yith'Mor project was finalized, Ellydium had begun developing a guard frigate. As early as 4620 and 4621, there were small leaks of information about the corporation's desire to develop a ship with a new role. The main difficulty in creating the ship later named “Drag'Thir” was that it was almost impossible to use standard Ellydium crystal nodes. 

More complex elements were required. The needed parts were removed from living Crystallids only in 4624 for the first time. Information about the Ellydium’s study of these samples was passed on to the UMC and “The Frontier Voice” news agency by a source that remains unknown. Rumor has it that Natasha Cortés herself soon gave a good talking to the informant, making them realize the full extent of their mistakes.

Conrad Dimeni was able to convince the board of directors to use this as part of a promotional campaign for the new frigate. Shortly before the first “Drag'Thir” frigates rolled off the slipway, Ellydium issued a promotional publication about the creation of the new ship. One of the brochures, later withdrawn, indicated that the Leviathan power transfer technology was used in the creation of “Drag'Thir”. Some of the ship’s pilots noticed a suspicious similarity between some of the frigate’s elements and Liu Virus infected ships, but the Ellydium explicitly denied these rumors. 

The ship has performed admirably in combat. We will soon be expanding the procurement of “Drag'Thir” for our mercenaries. Nevertheless, there is a proposal to investigate the reasons for the disappearance of “The Frontier Voice” journalist at Pilgrim-11 and the possible involvement of the Ellydium corporation. We need to find out if the unregistered capabilities previously observed in “Waz'Got” are present in this ship as well.[/quote]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459272/7cd7f202ed3624f686fb7b1c769853c56f42f55c.jpg[/img]

There is some reason to believe that the corporation uses mostly basic civilian components to assemble the weapons, achieving high performance with a few high-tech parts. Some speculate about the corporation’s connection to a civilian company that existed on Earth at the time of the Invasion. Since the fate of Earth is not fully known at this point, there can be no evidence of such a connection.

notes.title: Special issue of “The Frontier Voice” news publication
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459272/ec118e5a52747a83a08db10f09f244a4fe52a1ca.jpg[/img]

[h3]Introduction:[/h3]

Greetings, dear viewers and listeners! Welcome to “The Frontier Voice”, this is Max “The Comet” speaking. This is the new format of our publication: the investigation. In this issue, we will describe the process of our investigative work towards finding out the mysteries behind various events in the Frontier sectors and share the results with you. Today, I will be travelling to the… Oh, what was the name of the system? Viong? Viol? Vior? Check it before publishing and update the recording. Anyway, my destination is Pilgrim-11. I have a meeting there.
[hr][/hr]
[h3]Recording 1[/h3]

I left my office in the New Ceres system and I’m currently travelling through the Eastern mining station. Let me tell you about the plan for today while I have time. First, I’m going to visit a research facility, and then I have a meeting with a local authority representative. I hope I can get the permission to publish a story on what the research facility discovered in their analysis of the artifact I found in the Solaris Wasteland and other similar objects. There was another lead I wanted to pursue, but I will talk about it only if it turns out to be a success. I will be recording almost constantly during this trip, just in case. 
[hr][/hr]
[h3]Recording 2[/h3]

I’m getting close to the Pilgrim-11 gate. It means that in a moment…

“Attention, ship A18-B84-D11, identify yourself!” 

It’s the Snow Leopard and Manul. I’ll have to answer.

“This is Max ‘The Comet’ from the Frontier Voice.”
“Great, we’ve been waiting for you. We have information about a Cartel trap set up for you in the Pilgrim-11. Our orders are to escort you safely to the meeting point. Let’s do it this way: go through the portal, and we will follow in a few seconds. Change your phase modulator as soon as you go through. The Cartel won’t be able to catch you, and we will have time to deal with them.”
“Alright. Are you sure it’s safe? My ship only has civilian grade defence hardware. Maybe I can just go through another portal?”
“Don’t worry, everything is under control. We don’t need other portals, and besides, we will get in trouble if we don’t escort you. We will tow your ship to the meeting point if necessary.”

Looks like I have no choice. I will turn on automatic data upload, just in case. If they take my recordings, people will still learn the truth.

“Roger that. Heading towards the gate.”
[hr][/hr]
[h3]Recording 3[/h3]

I’m about to teleport. Phase modulator, please do your thing.

“There he is! Hey, ‘Comet’, your trip is over… Where did he go? He’s not on the radars! Find him! He has to die.”

They were right, there are a few Cartel ships here. I hope the backup arrives soon.

“Someone else is coming through the gate. Frank, don’t let the ‘Comet’ escape. Aim for his engines as soon as you see him. And turn on the locator already!”
“Sure, I…”
“Frank? Ah, dam…”

My escort did a great job. Both pirates died almost immediately.

“You guys are no joke. But why did I have to go first? You could have destroyed them anyway.”
“They were after you; they wouldn’t have dropped their camouflage if they hadn’t seen your ship. Now, keep close and let’s go.”
“Alright.”
[hr][/hr]
[h3]Recording 4[/h3]

Well, I’m at the meeting point. I hope there will be no more trouble. I am recording with my spacesuit mic.

“Good afternoon, Max. Let’s cut to the chase: our facility will need good advertising. This business will require a lot of effort and time. And today I want to know how much you know about Precursors and their artifacts.”
“You’re interviewing the interviewer? Not bad. Well, the Precursors are a civilization or several civilizations that ruled the galaxy probably two and a half million years ago. They created the Signal. The two known species of Aliens, the Crystallids and the Bions, both have a definite connection to them. At the same time, it seems to me that Aliens are not Precursors. Simply because the living planets and spaceships look somewhat... artificial? Precursor artifacts were created at very different times, but it’s not clear whether they were made by the hands of living beings or with some sort of machinery. According to available photos, there were humanoid statues on PB-42, for example.”
“Wait, you know about the PB-42?”
“Of course I do, it’s my professional duty. However, this story was deemed too disturbing, and therefore not published.”
“And you’re openly stating this? It might be a little unsafe. What if you were talking to an Ellydium spy?”
“It wouldn’t make any difference. That story must never see the light of day, but it is still recorded, as are some other stories. Just in case of... contingencies. Let’s get back to the Precursors.”
“Okay. What you said was pretty accurate. The age of old Precursor artifacts is around 2.58 to 2.6 million years old. You told us about the discovery of the column. It... is of great interest because the Signal concentrators, if found, could point to the source of the Signal. However, this will be very difficult to do without equipment from Earth, which is currently unavailable for obvious reasons. The main thing you will have to cover in your story is the potential of learning about the source of the Signal.”
“Alright, when should I expect you to give me the materials?”
“In the near future. And now I’m sorry, I have to leave you. My superiors want to talk to you now. Goodbye.”
“Alright, see you later.”
[hr][/hr]
[h3]Recording 5[/h3]

Now for the meeting with the local official. I think I will be able to learn what is actually wrong in the Frontier. Soon, I…
[b][Connection lost][/b]
[hr][/hr]
[h3]Recording 6[/h3]

Request transmission. Starting the emergency data transfer protocols. Checking whether editing is possible. Editing is not available. Server wait time has been exceeded. [b]Code: [u]000895213[/u][/b]

This is Max “The Comet” speaking. I hope this message never sees the light of day. I recorded it for an occasion when my life will be in danger. In the event that I go missing for an extended period of time, or turn on the emergency data feed, this message, along with the current version of my materials, perhaps not fully ready for publication, will be sent and posted to the official “Frontier Voice” channel. Pay no attention to the automated notifications before this post, they play no role. Max “The Comet”, signing off. “The Frontier Voice” advises that you remain cautious when visiting Frontier sectors, and that you only travel via safe routes.

notes.title: Special issue of “The Frontier Voice” news publication
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459272/2c1076a640b76a5f77b40ce0b72bb09f0cb22ec2.jpg[/img]

[i]New Ceres[/i]

Greetings, dear viewers and listeners! Welcome to “The Frontier Voice”, this is Max “The Comet” speaking. In today’s issue:
[olist]
[*] Righteous revenge or lynching? The Sargas Fund announced the destruction of “Asclepius” and everyone involved with it.
[*] “Forge steel and preserve humanity.” General Ironside’s address to the citizens of the galaxy.
[*] The horrible truth: discomforting statistics on the numbers of dead and missing pilots.
[*] The Atlas shrugs? New corporation “Atlas” Weapon Factories enters the market.
[/olist]

[hr][/hr]
The pirates who called themselves “Asclepius” volunteer organistaion are no more. Deputy finance director of the Sargas Fund announced successful elimination of the group. He posted the following on social media:

[quote]These bastards are gone, every single one of them, their leaders, coordinators, members of all ranks, stolen goods dealers. But we won’t stop at that. We will end every scumbag who received even half a credit from that gang. Lowlives of the galaxy, you will suffer the same fate. Let the fall of ‘Asclepius’ be a lesson to you.[/quote]

This post was deleted three hours after publication and was replaced with this statement: “Our forces have successfully located and neutralized the bandit group. ‘Asclepius’ will no longer kidnap and rob people.”

[hr][/hr]
General Ironside addressed all citizens of the galaxy. Here is a brief summary of his speech:

[quote]People of the galaxy! Today, humanity is divided, our worlds are still torn by conflicts and disputes. Even the Empire, the symbol of united humanity, has been fractured. Look what this has led to! Our home, the Earth, is lost to us. The Alien Invasion devastated dozens of thousands of planets, trillions have lost their lives. Felony, Solaris, Eridan, Monolith, Steperfide. The list of lost systems and worlds goes on and on.

Imperials, Federates, Jerichones, Revenants, the Emperor, Bartle, our electronic friends! I speak now to all of you. We have to stop star conflict for at least a moment. 

For everyone who thinks my words to be naive, I have some questions for you. Are you sure that the next Invasion is not about to start? Are you sure that millions of hunters are not going to breach the borders of inhabited systems tomorrow? Are you sure that the cybers in their service are not about to open new gates to the Alien worlds?

Humanity must unite to face the threats that tear our galaxy apart. Only together we can find our way and not become slaves to biomorphs. I pledge that I will do whatever it takes to quench the flame of the ongoing conflict.[/quote]

These words sound very unusual coming from Ironside. It’s very tempting to agree with his general message, but only time will tell how sincere this speech really is and what will it lead to. For now, let’s move on to our next story.

[hr][/hr]
Over a few past months, the number of dead and missing pilots in the Frontier has increased by a third, almost reaching the level of the Invasion and Portal Storm period. This tendency is noticeable both in the low stability regions and in well-protected systems. At the same time, according to public reports from every well-known state institutions, general pirate activity has lowered to roughly the levels prior to the recent Enclave crisis. We urge our viewers and listeners to remain extra cautious until the situation is clarified. Use safe routes and coordinate your movement with system patrols, declaring your flight in advance with system authorities.

[hr][/hr]
And the last big news at the moment is the “Atlas” Weapon Factories. This new corporation has started production of new weapons. At the moment it is known that the Steel Legion, Helion corporation and, it seems, some anonymous Jericho buyer have ordered a trial batch. It’s hard to think of a better advertisement for weapons. Nevertheless, the appearance of a previously unknown company on the market at a time when tensions in the galaxy are rising seems to be natural. Little is known about the corporation itself, but after doing a little investigation of our own, we have come to the conclusion that rumours of a new hidden military base somewhere in the Felony system may be connected to the “Atlas” Weapon Factories. At the moment, our news agency cannot advise on the quality of their products, but having any weapons on your ship is a good idea. It increases the safety of living in the Frontier.

[hr][/hr]
“The Frontier Voice” thanks you for your attention. We plan to release another investigation in an upcoming issue. No details yet, but it’s highly likely that you, dear viewers and listeners, will witness a sensational discovery. Max “The Comet”, signing off.

notes.title: Special issue of “The Frontier Voice” news publication
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459272/fae39cab61316543d0c13039d6b333c2aec245bc.jpg[/img]

[h3]Introduction[/h3]

Greetings, dear viewers and listeners! Welcome to “The Frontier Voice”, this is Max “The Comet” speaking. This is the new format of our publication: the investigation. In this issue, we will describe the process of our investigative work towards finding out the mysteries behind various events in the Frontier sectors and share the results with you. Today we will talk about our trip to the Solaris Wasteland.

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Flight logbook detailing the trip to the Solaris Wasteland with commentary[/h2]

The reason “The Frontier Voice” decided to investigate the Solaris Wasteland is the information provided by our sources that linked the mysterious messages discussed in the last issue with that location. The anomaly discovered by our correspondent at Pandora had the same signature as an unidentified object, which appeared for a little while in the Solaris system.

[h3]Entry 1[/h3]
[quote]Successfully arrived to the Wasteland through the gate at the Ruined station. The pirates either didn’t notice me or thought that my outdated ship had no value.[/quote]

[h3]Entry 2[/h3]
[quote]There are still a lot of Crystallids in the area. I have to be careful. My contact is not responding.[/quote]

[h3]Entry 3[/h3]
[quote]My contact is probably dead. The communication station has been destroyed. I will have to investigate alone.[/quote]
[i]Author’s comment[/i]: subsequent analysis of the video footage showed metal pieces of the communication station wreckage flying by in several shots.

[h3]Entry 4[/h3]
[quote]There is nothing at the supposed location of the anomaly. Not even debris. Was I tricked? What if this is a trap?
Ship’s onboard assistant: Attention! The right engine power supply is cut off! Attention! The left engine power supply is cut off. The main energy supply is malfunctioning. Backup energy supply is inoperative. Right engine gas emissions’ temperature is too high. Turn on the system of magnetic field concentrators.[/quote]
[i]Author’s comment[/i]: some of the ship’s systems malfunctioned. But this malfunction was what allowed me to find the object.

[h3]Entry 5 [/h3]
[quote]Located the anomaly. It is a small column covered in glyphs. The ship’s sensors glitch upon approach to it. The disruptions are similar to those that my colleague encountered in Pandora.[/quote]
[i]Author’s comment[/i]: I was able to effectively use the ship’s systems without rebooting thanks to the ferrite system of magnetic field concentrators.

[h3]Entry 6[/h3]
[quote]I managed to get a sample of the material, I’ll have to show it to a specialist I know, maybe he’ll agree to analyze it. For now, I can see that this column is… moving? But where? There are no objects in that direction in the system, and no objects in the opposite direction. It can’t be traveling between stars, can it? The glyphs on it... Wait, I thought I took pictures of them…[/quote]
[i]Author’s comment[/i]: part of my flight logbook was lost. At close range, the anomaly was strong enough to interfere with the ship’s systems. No relevant or important information was lost. I deemed it too unsafe to stay in the system any longer. So when I spotted a pair of Crystallid hunters on my radar, I made the decision to leave the system.

Recording of a conversation with a PhD who agreed to examine the specimen. The name of the scientist is not disclosed by his request.
[quote]“Hello, doctor. I was able to find an artifact, probably belonging to the Precursors, and take a sample of the material. What can you tell me about it?”

“Good afternoon, Max. Let’s take a look at its structure. Well, what can I tell you? It’s a composite. The base is a glass-like form of iridium, and the inclusions are silver.”

“And what does that mean, Doctor?”

“It’s a kind of lens. For the Signal. This column, as you put it, can amplify or concentrate the electromagnetic field. What it’s for, I can’t say. But the fact that your ship was able to withstand it at all is very lucky. If a standard composite focuses the field billions of times, the efficiency of this artifact’s material is many orders of magnitude stronger.”

“Still, what could be its purpose?”

“It's hard to say. I would guess that it could be some sort of beacon for navigation, or maybe a Signal modulation repeater. What I mean by that is that this artifact could be a node that would relay information to the Signal sources that the overall Signal intensity needs to be changed or... even turned off. If you find more artifacts, we might be able to find a way to cut off the nasty Signal. Not only will you be thanked by all the people who overpaid for stabilizers for all electrical appliances, but also by astrophysicists. The Signal is distorting information about the universe and slowing down star exploration. We still can’t get an automatic search for planets suitable for colonization because of it.”

“Thank you for your answers, doctor. If I find anything else of interest, I will definitely contact you for further research.”[/quote]
[i]Author’s comment[/i]: further research by the scientist revealed that the object is very old. It is hundreds of thousands, perhaps millions of years old. It also seems to be older than all known Biones and Precursor structures. We will try to find out why the artifact was found only now, even though Jericho was thorough in its control over the system. Could it be that neither Mendes nor the Techs could find the cursed column, which was only a hundred kilometers away from the transit point? Or maybe it was the reason for the destruction of both the Techs’ station and the Mendes evacuation fleet?

Max “The Comet”, signing off. “The Frontier Voice” advises that you remain cautious when visiting Frontier sectors, and that you have backup on-board systems and methods of dealing with the Signal and various interference. We will keep you updated.

notes.title: The Frontier Voice — INTERNAL UMC REPORT
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459272/d32ff393d36fce1926a63c93d1651f2517c12488.jpg[/img]
[i]Internal UMC report[/i]

Our Jericho “friend” who has been to the anomaly and seen the glyphs has figured out the location they point towards. The reasons why someone was able to intercept the message and forward all the ciphers to the mercenaries are unknown. Since information about the messages has been made public, the truth should be hidden behind various meaningless riddles as soon as possible. It might even be worth giving away the full set of red herrings to some journalist. 

Now to the results of deciphering the messages. Our engineers have thoroughly investigated each part of the message and came to the following conclusions:
[olist]
[*] The line about bleary light meant the evolution of stars. So we needed to find two stars with approximately the same parameters, but different stages of existence. The parameters of the star in the Pandora system and an anomaly in the same system were taken as samples. Among the objects that matched these parameters and were associated with Aliens or Precursors were Mezza, Pallas, and (with low probability) Solaris.
[*] Subsequent clues revealed that some of the previous parts of the message were misguidance. According to our findings, it was the words about stellar evolution that were to mislead the recipient of the message. 
[*] An expert in the field of toponymy offered the following solution to the riddle: an area of the Solaris system known as the “Orange Giant”. The star Solaris is similar to the Pandora anomaly in its emission spectrum, and the Orange Giant is the future phase of that star.
[/olist]
Based on these findings, we are planning to investigate the Solaris system. Several pilots have already been appointed to this mission. The best position for a communications station in the system has not yet been determined. The main difficulty of the upcoming operation is that we will have to hide our true interests. For that reason, it is not advisable to use Sentinel platforms. Also, according to preliminary reports, unknown signatures similar to Ellydium ships have been spotted in the system. Additional forces are required to investigate the details.

notes.title: Special issue of “The Frontier Voice” news publication
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459272/7e09f7d96513b999ece0af79ce2be8e70148c99b.jpg[/img]

Greetings, dear viewers and listeners! Welcome to “The Frontier Voice”, this is Max “The Comet” speaking to your from a new office. In today’s issue:
[olist]
[*] From Asclepius to Thanatos: rescue volunteer unit turned out to be a pirate brigade in disguise
[*] No freedom for the enemies of freedom: the Alliance of Free Worlds announces a ban of a number of controversial media outlets
[*] Threat eliminated: the Armada press center announces that the Alien issue in the Olympus system has been resolved
[*] Mysterious message: where does it lead and what does it mean?
[/olist]

The “Asclepius” volunteer unit turned out to be a pirate gang. They kidnapped the son of the deputy head of the Sargas Fund finance department, and demanded a ransom of forty million credits. Sargas has already issued an official statement claiming the involvement of Sparta’s intelligence services and demanding that the threat posed by this “pseudo-state” be eliminated. However, no substantial evidence of Sparta’s involvement with “Asclepius” was ever presented. Moreover, some of the “Asclepius” ships were purchased with grant money from the Sargas Fund.

The Alliance of Free Worlds has withdrawn licenses from several provocative media outlets: “The Will of Mankind”, “True Faith”, and “Federation Volley”. According to official sources of the Atlantic Alliance, the reason for banning these news outlets is the dissemination of unverified information, which is unacceptable on the territory of the Federation. According to our source, the real reason was the extremist statements made by these media about Armada. 
I remind you that “The Frontier Voice” is impartial to the political interests of any state and does not represent the official opinion of any party to a possible conflict. Our job is to report on events in the Frontier sectors and to save lives whenever possible.

The Armada press center shared a good news: the Aliens that infiltrated the Olympus system (we wrote about that in our last issue) have been successfully eliminated by the joint efforts of Armada and UMC mercenaries. Connie Aren gave us a comment: “This time, the Aliens have been purged from the system. However, do not assume that the Abandoned Beacon is safe, I urge everyone to be vigilant, especially in these troubled times.” “The Frontier Voice” fully supports this statement. Stay vigilant, dear viewers and listeners!

Our final story for today is a mysterious one. The UMC has recorded a number of cryptic messages. Some are easy to decipher, some are almost impossible. [url=https://forms.gle/x4tyESH1NYRBrp6n7]Together, they should probably point to some place[/url].

notes.title: Star Conflict 1.13.1а UMC archives: Sparks of sentiment
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459272/0961e1723f673192f70fded9480ad982a0961241.jpg[/img]

After his wife Valentina passed away, Robert Sanderson’s life was filled with cold determination. His ship “Cor Vulnus”, originally designed for civilian use, now had a new purpose. Working day and night at an abandoned shipyard, Robert had transformed the ship, equipping it with powerful weapons and electronic warfare systems. The bitterness of loss became fuel for innovation, and the memory of Valentina became a quiet whisper that inspired action.

Soon, the “Cor Vulnus” was ordered to take part in an operation to blockade the infested areas of the New Babylon system. During the battle, the ship encountered a group of former Empire personnel and Robert’s newest systems worked flawlessly, neutralizing enemy signals and giving the crew an advantage.

This victory was a turning point for the entire galaxy. Robert turned a personal tragedy into a symbol of renewal and resistance, and his creation into a beacon of hope. A new song played aboard the ship: a reminder that even in the darkest of times, love and selflessness can bring about the dawn of the future.

[hr][/hr][h1]Rank 16 Imperial ECM Interceptor “Cor Vulnus” is available again![/h1]

[previewyoutube=emmkwNWP73Q;full][/previewyoutube]

At the very beginning of the Invasion, Robert Sanderson worked in one of the Empire’s numerous shipyards as a lead engineer. In his spare time he was designing a small rescue ship to build a single copy to give to his wife Valentina Vega, a doctor on the “Drake” with the personal name “Alexander von Werner”.

In 4615, “Alexander von Werner” arrived to conduct a human evacuation of New Babylon, which was being infected by the biomorph virus. On the fifth day, New Babylon fell out of orbit and the Legion fleet declared its blockade. On the same day, an infestation of the Liu-virus broke out on the “Alexander”.

Thanks to the work of Valentina, it was possible to save 70% of the ship’s crew. The Legion evacuated healthy people and the doctor, but Valentina died of complications on the way home before she could send a letter to her husband. Robert took the death of his wife hard, but completing the project became a matter of principle for him. However, the Galaxy no longer needed purely civilian ships, so Sanderson developed weapons and electronic warfare systems for his brainchild, and he approached this task with all the persistence of a man creating Legion ships.

In 4622 Robert was able to assemble the ship’s prototype, naming it Cor Vulnus. The ship turned out to be unique and effective enough to get Gabriel Hugot’s attention. The aristocrat negotiated with Robert Sanderson and started production of the new interceptors at his shipyard. The UMC was able to negotiate the ability to purchase some of the manufactured ships. The queue for purchase is booked for months in advance, so mercenaries looking to acquire a “Cor Vulnus” in the near future should get the attention of Gabriel Hugot or Robert Sanderson.

notes.title: Special issue of “The Frontier Voice” news publication
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459272/dabcab0baf51e0081f30911ff708aa9a9d5d4788.jpg[/img]
[i]Olympus system[/i]

Greetings, dear viewers and listeners! Welcome to “The Frontier Voice”, this is Max “The Comet” speaking. In today’s issue:
[olist]
[*] They risk their lives for loot: the dangers of hunting rich asteroids in the Frontier sector
[*] Spartan lifestyle: report from one of the Sparta orbital station where people are in dire need of food, medicine and air filters
[*] Frontier anomalies: are they really a threat? 
[*] Aliens spotted in the Olympus system: new encounters with the unknown.
[/olist]

Private individuals are organizing an improvised trading in the Erebus and Pride systems by mining resources from asteroids. They often use tools and lasers not designed for mining. Such actions not only reduce the chance of extraction, but also risk blowing up the asteroid into pieces. Right now, our sources have no information on fatalities, but more than a dozen ships have been sent to shipyards for extensive repairs due to such “shenanigans”. Members of the newly formed “Asclepius” volunteer unit are patrolling the systems to assist those affected. We advise you to exercise caution and remind you that only specialized equipment should be used for asteroid mining, such as the ML-V2 issued by the UMC.

Our correspondent visited one of Sparta’s orbital settlements on the outskirts of the Felony system. People are in a difficult situation because of the conflict between Sparta and the Republic of Separate Worlds. Recently there was a major accident on the station and one of the life support nodes has failed. The situation is critical, if repairs are not made immediately, air regeneration on the station will become impossible. Nevertheless, people are refusing to evacuate.

Frontier sectors continue to surprise us with unsolved mysteries. Our correspondent was travelling to the Felony system when he found himself in the middle of a previously unknown anomaly in the Pandora system. Unlike the “usual” communication-breaking sections, this location did not affect any of the ship's systems except for engines. Before they were restarted, our correspondent took a few pictures. The resulting images showed glyphs of an ancient civilization, perhaps even the Precursors. Unfortunately, when the ship's reactor had to be shut down to restart the engines, much of the data was lost. Exercise extreme caution when travelling in the Frontier. Your lives are worth more than alien artifacts and the ruins of dead civilizations.

And now for the big news of the hour: my investigation has uncovered alien presence at the Abandoned Beacon in the Olympus system. With the help of my “Night hawk”, I was able to get close range photos of a Crystallid hunter and even managed to plant a spy bot on it. Before the bot was destroyed, I was able to find out that there was more than one Crystallid in the system. But what does this mean? A new invasion or a mere accident? That remains to be seen. In case of an alien encounter, immediately report to the organization controlling the territory.

Max “The Comet”, signing off. “The Frontier Voice” is always ready to take information from you, dear viewers. If you have encountered dangers in the Frontier, please inform us immediately, then we will be able to notify the residents of the sectors in time about a possible pirate ambush or a new safe route.

[hr][/hr]

Immediately after the start of the second Alien Invasion, the Seventh Squadron realized that the Armada was in no hurry to defend Federation territory and decided to develop a new line of ships to increase the ability of mobile cities to defend themselves. A destroyer was proposed as the type of the future defence ship, since it was durable enough to survive multiple hits from a Crystallid predator and was more mobile and affordable than any cruiser.

Since developing a ship from scratch would have taken an enormous amount of time and the Seventh Squadron had limited resources, it was decided to base the design on “Invincible” blueprints. Engineers replaced all the materials with modern ones, supplied iridium energy lines, and scientists developed a device called an “axion core”. The principle of its operation was not disclosed to the public, but one press release stated that this energy core could break the barrier between ordinary and dark matter, and was also capable of creating a vacuum break between axions. The next day, the document was removed at the request of the Federation Security Service due to “copyright infringement”.

In 4623, the project codenamed DB-7SAS-18-H-E11 saw the light of day. Testing of the ship’s combat capabilities was broadcast live.

The broadcast was curious for two reasons: firstly, the pilot painted the ship a couple of hours before the flight, tuning it to look like an eastern dragon and giving the ship a personal name 718-BASHE; and secondly, Enclave pirates decided to capture the ship for fun.

The destroyer was shooting AI-controlled combat drones to test the ship’s effectiveness in near combat conditions when the pirates entered the system. The pilot considered this a routine continuation of the tests and immediately fired at the new “targets”. The pirates were able to penetrate the destroyer’s shields, and one of their shots hit the wormhole generator. Suddenly, an electrical discharge ran through the ship, triggering an emergency launch of a wormhole that reached the enemy ship in a split second. A chain of charges ran between the pirates’ ships, severely damaging them and forcing them to try to retreat.

The unexpected behaviour of the modules forced the Seventh Squadron to spend a year refining the operation of the ship’s onboard systems and its unique capabilities. After that, mass assembly of “Bashe” ships began at the shipyards of Seventh Squadron and Blackwood corporation.

[hr][/hr][h1]Unique rank 17 suppression destroyer “Bashe”[/h1]

[previewyoutube=n4j2Kq_nNuA;full][/previewyoutube]

Immediately after the start of the second Alien Invasion, the Seventh Squadron realized that the Armada was in no hurry to defend Federation territory and decided to develop a new line of ships to increase the ability of mobile cities to defend themselves. A destroyer was proposed as the type of the future defence ship, since it was durable enough to survive multiple hits from a Crystallid predator and was more mobile and affordable than any cruiser.

Since developing a ship from scratch would have taken an enormous amount of time and the Seventh Squadron had limited resources, it was decided to base the design on “Invincible” blueprints. Engineers replaced all the materials with modern ones, supplied iridium energy lines, and scientists developed a device called an “axion core”. The principle of its operation was not disclosed to the public, but one press release stated that this energy core could break the barrier between ordinary and dark matter, and was also capable of creating a vacuum break between axions. The next day, the document was removed at the request of the Federation Security Service due to “copyright infringement”.

In 4623, the project codenamed DB-7SAS-18-H-E11 saw the light of day. Testing of the ship’s combat capabilities was broadcast live.

The broadcast was curious for two reasons: firstly, the pilot painted the ship a couple of hours before the flight, tuning it to look like an eastern dragon and giving the ship a personal name 718-BASHE; and secondly, Enclave pirates decided to capture the ship for fun.

The destroyer was shooting AI-controlled combat drones to test the ship’s effectiveness in near combat conditions when the pirates entered the system. The pilot considered this a routine continuation of the tests and immediately fired at the new “targets”. The pirates were able to penetrate the destroyer’s shields, and one of their shots hit the wormhole generator. Suddenly, an electrical discharge ran through the ship, triggering an emergency launch of a wormhole that reached the enemy ship in a split second. A chain of charges ran between the pirates’ ships, severely damaging them and forcing them to try to retreat.

The unexpected behaviour of the modules forced the Seventh Squadron to spend a year refining the operation of the ship’s onboard systems and its unique capabilities. After that, mass assembly of “Bashe” ships began at the shipyards of Seventh Squadron and Blackwood corporation.

notes.title: New ship review with Lucas Horn: “Bashe”
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459272/c0694292b1dfc6241210e954a072c7418fd1e16f.jpg[/img]

Attention, pilots! This is Lucas Horn. My officers have intercepted a message from one of the Blackwood shipyard production sites. It contains information about the new ship that will soon be available to the UMC. Let’s have a closer look at the secret design, parts of which even had to be hidden among the files of the old Imperial destroyer “Invincible”, especially since even a rookie can clearly see that some parts of the new ship were clearly inspired by the “Salamander” frigate, released just a year prior by the same manufacturer. 

For starters, the ship they created has a code name DB-7SAS-18-H-E11, which stumps even the most literate mercenaries, so let’s just call it “Bashe”, short and sweet.

[b]The design uses the Pivoting hull plates[/b] that allow the ship to bend following the slightest move of its helm. It can smoothly pass by asteroids (or small planets, considering the signature and cruising speed of the ship) and fit between the rocks of the Devil’s Jaw or lava canyons of the Naberia-392 complex. Originally, the ship could bend at much sharper angles, but it affected the test pilots’ behaviour: they couldn’t help but start playing a game of “Snake” (a videogame that was found on ancient Finnish communication devices). They would inevitably crash the ship’s front into its own rear and completely forget that they were supposed to be testing the thing. That is why the decision to reduce the pivot angle was made…

As for the weapons, the destroyer is equipped with the [b]Ion plasma cannon “Snake”[/b], which has three modes:
[olist]
[*] “Basic” for those who are in a hurry; it’s perfect for the situations when the adrenaline is pumping in your veins and your finger smashes the trigger with 240 bpm frequency;
[*] “Thoughtful” for when your finger lingers just a bit before pushing the launch button: it doubles the power of the plasma charge and transforms it into a blue ring that destroys everything in its path and leaves an expanding trace behind; 
[*] “Thorough” for the cold-headed pilots, capable of holding the button for more than 5 seconds. The plasma charge becomes a purple ring, its power increases by 5 times, and it blasts off to the next galaxy, burning any ship that gets in its way.
[/olist]

[b]The “Deceptive maneuver” special module[/b] is often called “skin shedder” among the staff. It makes the ship go invisible for 5 seconds and simultaneously make a very fast leap forward (especially fast for a destroyer). It also leaves a decoy copy of the ship behind, which tries to look busy and lights up the space in a variety of different colours. This module can provide many opportunities for pilots to surprise the enemy. For instance, be sure to try out this Lifehack: use a Wormhole projector to create a wormhole before activating the module, then activate the wormhole while still being invisible.

[b]The active “Lightning” homing system[/b] constantly follows the closest enemy within 10-kilometer radius semi-sphere (its location depends on the module’s positioning), and upon activation sends a charge to the semi-sphere, which also deals damage in a chain to all other enemies up to 10 km around the original target. In the end, you deal more than 20,000 EM damage to three targets. And you don’t have to even aim, you can have a nap and then just push the button, and “Bashe” will take care of the rest.

[b]The “Weapon destabilizer” unique modifier[/b] reduces all enemy weapons and modules damage by 30% within a 750 m radius sphere around the ship. While you may have powerful spherical Reflecting shields (that don’t reflect anything within the sphere), those still don’t work like this module: permanently active with no cooldown! So any close attacks to you will always have half the power. Just imagine, the module reduces the damage of Plasma Arcs, Rams, Webs, Rays, Clouds, Crystals, Anomalies and even GPBs activated within the sphere. If you’re also skilled with your active and special modules and “Bashe” weapons, your ship becomes a very dangerous target for anyone who wants to get close for an attack.
     
[b]The “Snake skin” unique modifier[/b] provides a good old classic 20% boost to hull durability and adds 15 points of resistance to all types of damage. Just this one feature makes “Bashe” the most durable destroyer in our galaxy! 

In conclusion, it is no surprise that the Blackwood shipyard was hiding this design by misguiding inattentive spies. Let’s also not forget that the “Bashe” model supplied to mercenaries across the galaxy has no maintenance cost. Any shipyard will work on it for free! You can plunge into any adventure and pull off the most wild attacks and still manage to repair your ship afterwards without having to take out a huge loan or pray for credits at the “Sanctuary”!

In any case, good luck to all pilots in their ventures and battles, great loot and free space to you all!

notes.title: Results of the big Star Conflict winter survey
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459272/2c311817c6c28c33a3371fa7560fc90578451c4a.jpg[/img]

Pilots, it’s time to look at the results of the Big Winter Survey! Today we’re going to reveal all the secrets of who actually plays these computer games of yours. Let’s fly on!
[hr][/hr]
In total, almost 1000 people completed the survey.

As it turns out, most pilots are between the ages of 24 and 35. This is almost 38%. Another 23% said they were “an old Thar’Ga”. And almost 22% were older than 35. Pre-retirement age!

As we thought, almost all of our pilots are boys. There are almost 89% of them. Another 5% of pilots are girls. The rest are biomorphs.

More than 34% are from Western Europe. Another 29% are from North America. And 18% are from Eastern Europe. The rest are scattered around the world. 

In addition to shooting biomorphs, more than 52% of respondents also work! Our condolences. 15% are studying. More than 16% are UMC mercenaries. The rest are retirees, managers of the universe, and astral explorers. That’s what they mentioned in the “Other” column.

The majority of players learned about the Star Conflict universe from advertising on websites. This is 33%. Another 27% were invited by friends. And 11% played with their brothers a long time ago and now decided to come back and remember how great it was. The years go by. The universe is heading toward its thermal death...

Almost 64% of respondents said that they are so old that they saw how the universe began, how worlds were created and destroyed... They’ve been playing the game for that long. Another 24% have been playing for more than a year. 4% play for six months. And another 7% have just started playing.

At the same time, almost 80% of the pilots in the game reached rank 13 and above. And there are only 6% of beginners with a level up to 6.

Preferences on the sides of the conflict were divided almost evenly:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459272/df81757594cc8c1b88f53596370b4e1a13acb934.png[/img]

Our pilots play a lot. 30% noted that they disappear in the game for several days a week. And another 66% spend a couple of hours a week playing the game. Another 4% do leave the game at all.

Most of all, players like to play PvE. There are 77% of them. Another 18% prefer to explore the Open space. And 39% enjoy playing PvP.

Almost 56% play computer games every day. Another 16% play 3–4 days a week.

Most of all, pilots love to play space simulators. There are 47% of such players. Another 42% like strategy games. 39% prefer fantasy RPGs. And 38% like action games. The Cyberpunk theme is close to 20% of players. Here you could choose multiple answers.
[hr][/hr]
Happy holidays, pilots! And we are off to read all your comments and remarks! Always in touch, your UMC.
[list]
[*] Keep up the good work, I know it isnt easy especially trying to balance so many ships and weapons etc. Keep at it though despite its issues the game is still fun thanks to yours efforts. Happy Holidays when they come
[*] Thanks for this good game.
[*] I remember playing Star Conflict back in 2015-2017 for about 3,000 hours when I was around 8-10 and I was absolutely hooked, but in recent years I haven't really played as there isn't an english (or really any) playerbase at all. It's amazing to see my childhood game still receiving updates. I still love the flying dynamics and the GRAPHICS, (this game is SO beautiful). I see you guys had really poured your heart out into this game in previous years. I hope all of you have an awesome christmas.
[*] Thank you to the entire Star Conflict Team for all the hard work you are doing- 0w0 is excited to see the new content in open space and the new ships as well (more Ellydium please). Stay safe and Happy Hunting!
[*] Thanks for all the great content over the years! Can't wait to dive back in to rank up to pro.
[*] Thank you for keeping this game alive. It's one of my all-time favorites. I hope I'll still be able to play Star Conflict years into the future, one way or another.
[/list]

Dear pilots, from the depths of our hearts we wish you all the best, a Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year!

See you next year! 

Your beloved UMC

notes.title: The lost door. Part 7. Darkness
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459272/a4e4db305ea273db0624e0c1f036f904bd5777e8.jpg[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/212070/view/3714964345763801306
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/212070/view/6173930465533484092
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/212070/view/3735231811750624580
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/212070/view/3886107476401847006
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/212070/view/4445710170455015475
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/212070/view/4450215038309893288
[hr][/hr]


It turned out that it was simply impossible to get close to the station. Some sort of field had recently appeared around it and prevented any ships from approaching the town. Perhaps this was the technical obstacle Olaf was referring to. However, I suspect they would never destroy Oars under any circumstances. They wanted the same thing I was after, I was sure of it. The decoder key to the Black Abyss gate, that’s what brought everyone here. It must be the source of the contagion. That’s how the Unnamable usually works. 

The Empire patrol ship gave my spacesuit the acceleration it needed and sent me on a long journey on a tricky trajectory that brought me to the walls of Oars after a few hours of boredom. I suppose I could have tried to penetrate the field in my ship, but I didn’t want to show off all my abilities and secrets before time.

Getting into the town turned out to be easy. Oars was a jumble of old ships and orbital stations, welded together to form a labyrinth of tunnels. There were hatches and doors everywhere, left over from the original junk that was used to build the town and carved out by locals who were probably up to some dark deeds. I just found the nearest airlock and got in without a problem.

I took off my spacesuit and walked the dark corridors to finally get to the so-called streets of the town. They were more like narrow branching passageways between steel walls, with lots of small shops, cafés and cheap housing. The favelas of the modern world. There were no citizens in sight. Only the dim emergency light filled the streets. A couple of times I thought I was being watched from the window slits nearby, but I didn’t see any people. Having a rough idea of how the decoder key worked, I headed confidently towards the town centre.

The closer I got, the clearer it became that I was not mistaken. I began to see corpses in the street. Completely blackened and twisted. The closer to the centre I got, the more there were. The key attracts the infected, drives them to walk towards it, and only death could stop them. Though sometimes it didn’t.

As I got closer to the small square that was the centre of the town, I started bumping into infected who were still alive. They were no longer able to move, so they sat or lay there, watching me with blackened eyes. With every step of the way, there were more and more infected. I was not afraid to catch the disease from them. I had a special gift that Ms Hate had given me a long time ago, especially for cases like this. But I still didn’t want to touch the infected. They looked pretty bad. Luckily, they stepped aside as I went, letting me pass. And so I came to the central square of the town of Oars.

What I saw there was quite interesting. Several people in dark robes stood right in front of me. Their hoods hid their faces. Across from them were the ones who had found the key. The power from the infected had made them noticeably stronger. One in particular stood out, a large man of athletic build. His angry eyes glared at the hooded people. Two other men stood next to him. It looked like they might have been brothers. Now all three looked the same. The key changes people if they’re exposed to it for too long. 
“We’ve come for what we ordered,” one of the hooded men said. “Give us what you owe us. We have brought the promised payment.” 
“You tricked me!” The voice of the centre man boomed like thunder. “You didn’t tell me what the wedge could actually give me! You wanted me to give it to you for a pittance of gold?” 
“We had an agreement.” 
“To hell with your agreement, you pathetic collectors! The wedge is mine!” He put his suddenly inhumanly long arms around the brothers, pulling them to him. “Did you think you could take it away and become its servants? No! I’ll do what it commands myself! And become its best friend, its assistant, its regent! Me! Alone!”

He pressed the brothers’ bodies even harder against him. In an instant, they were gone, and their empty clothes fell to the steel floor. The man himself grew even larger, almost resting his head against the ceiling tiles. His body rippled with muscle. His voice became like the call of the underworld. His arms swept towards the robed guys, becoming longer and turning into a tangle of snakes or steel ropes, tearing bodies apart in an instant. I stepped forward and pulled out the Duke. A huge, heavy and very ancient pistol loaded with special bullets. I managed to fire it three times. All three shots hit successfully. One even landed in the monster’s head. But he still managed to hit me with his tentacle arms. The gun flew out of my hands and rolled away, I was thrown back a couple of yards. It was hard to breathe. My body felt deadly heavy. I was almost gone. The monster wasn’t.

Despite its wounds, it moved towards me. I didn’t know what it was going to do to me and I didn’t want to find out. With a trembling hand, I reached for the amulet around my neck and snapped it. The monster stared at me for a second, not realising what was happening, and then fell to the floor. The key gleamed in its hand. It was very close, but I didn’t have the strength to move. I must have blacked out periodically. Several of my ribs were broken and one seemed to have punctured a lung. 

I don’t know how much time passed. Not that long, I guess, and then I heard footsteps and Imperial fighters ran out into the square. Following them came Olaf and Ramirez. Both were wearing heavy assault spacesuits, but there was no one left to fight. With the key’s owner dead, it was likely that all the infected on the station had perished as well, and the protective field was down. 

Olaf took out a huge cleaver and with a single blow severed the hand holding the key. Ramirez deftly picked up the limb and placed it in a container. It was obvious that they had prepared well.

“Let’s go,” Olaf commanded. “Time is of the essence!”

They left the square quickly, not even looking at me, and their support squads followed them. 

It was getting harder and harder to breathe. With a great effort, I did not let my body switch off completely. And I waited. After an abyss of time, I heard the footsteps of living people again in this realm of death. Stepping lightly, Summer entered the square. Huron and his crew followed her. 
“My poor faithful one.” Summer stepped over the corpse of the big guy and sat down beside me, placing her hand on my head. It made me feel better all at once. 
“It was all for nothing,” I whispered with dry lips. “They took the key.” 
“I know,” she smiled in a way that made all the pain go away. “It’s alright.” 
“They’re probably at the gate by now,” I coughed up blood. “It’s been too long.”
“We lost the battle, but not the war,” her voice was soft, captivating, enchanting. “He can be stopped. He is not omnipotent. But we will need everything we have.” Her eyes became bottomless, and I sank into them. Darkness fell…
