notes.title: Star Conflict 1.11.1 — Patch notes
notes.notes:
[h1]Balancing changes[/h1]

[h2]Weapons and slot ammunition[/h2]

[b]Plasma discharger[/b]
[list]
[*] The amount of energy burned increased to 5000 pts;
[/list][i]Comment: the previous amount of energy burned didn’t allow the unique feature of the weapon to be used effectively enough.[/i]
[list]
[*] Base spread reduced from 4.5 to 3.0 degrees.
[/list][i]Comment: the base spread is too high and makes the weapon unstable to use. Reducing the spread will balance the weapon and make it more attractive.[/i]

[b]Plasmatron[/b]
[list]
[*] Damage to your own ship is removed;
[*] Projectile damage, speed and size increased by 30%;
[/list][i]Comment: the weapon is practically useless in its current form.[/i]

[b]Turbophaser DN-1[/b]
[list]
[*] Critical damage bonus increased from 50% to 75%;
[*] Maximum spread reduced to 1 degr.;
[*] Projectile flight speed increased to 7000 m/s; 
[*] Weapon ranks changed to 7-17.
[/list][i]Comment: at the moment, this weapon is largely inferior to the Assault Railgun, including in terms of usability, providing only one unique feature in the form of EM damage. This change will increase the average damage of the weapon and make it more competitive. [/i]

[b]MIRV launcher[/b]
[list]
[*] Projectile speed increased from 1450 to 1800 m/s.
[/list][i]Comment: a slight increase in the relevance and convenience of firing.[/i]

[b]Attack drone (engineering)[/b]
[list]
[*] Damage increased by 10%;
[*] The drone’s durability increased by 600 pts. 
[/list][i]Comment: The drones of the engineers’ rocket compartment are outdated and uncompetitive compared to other drones.[/i]

[b]Crystal drone (for frigates)[/b]
[list]
[*] The drone’s range reduced from 12,500 to 7,000 m.
[/list][i]Comment: according to its characteristics, the crystal drone is superior to similar rocket blocks. [/i]

[b]Homing laser[/b]
[list]
[*] Energy consumption reduced by 33%.
[/list][i]Comment: firing this weapon drained the ship’s energy reserve  too quickly.[/i]

[b]EMR-3 launcher[/b]
[list]
[*] Projectile flight speed has been increased from 2500 to 3250 m/s.
[/list][i]Comment: the projectile’s flight speed was too slow to effectively hit manoeuvrable targets.[/i]

[b]Ion emitter, Pirate ion emitter [/b]
[list]
[*] Range reduced:[list]
[*] Ranks 7-9 — to 2500 m;
[*] Ranks 9-13 — to 2650 m;
[*] Ranks 12-17 — to 2800 m;
[/list][*] Time to overheat reduced from 11 to 8 seconds.
[/list][i]Comment: these changes are aimed at reducing the effectiveness of the weapon, forcing the pilots to take a more careful approach to setting up their ships.[/i]

[b]Heavy Repair Drone[/b]
[list]
[*] Durability increased to 2250 pts.
[/list]
[b]Vacuum-resonant laser[/b]
[list]
[*] The amount of additional temporary damage to the enemy reduced to 1000 pts/s.
[*] Now the amount of additional temporary damage to the enemy doesn’t change depending on the size and distance to the enemy ship.
[/list][i]Comment: this change is designed to simplify the implementation of additional damage to the weapon.[/i]

[b]‘Sk'Rah’ Launcher[/b]
[list]
[*] The cooling time of the weapon has been reduced to 1.5 seconds.
[/list][i]Comment: this change is aimed at improving the usability of the weapon on ships without a cooler. [/i]

[b]‘Tai'al’ launcher [/b]
[list]
[*] Missile rotation speed increased by 10 deg/s;
[*] Damage increased by 15%. 
[/list][i]Comment: these edits are designed to increase the effectiveness of the weapon.[/i]

[b]‘T'Har'Ok’ beamer[/b]
[list]
[*] The ball's flight speed has been increased to 125 m/s;
[*] The rate of fire of bullets has been increased by 20%.
[/list][i]Comment: these changes are aimed at improving the effectiveness of weapons in both firing modes.[/i]

[b]Tai'Thaq[/b]
[list]
[*] The rate of fire has been reduced from 90 to 70 shots/min.;
[*] Flight speed reduced from 4000 to 3000 m/s; 
[*] Damage reduced by 10%.
[/list][i]Comment: this weapon was unreasonably effective and very easy to use, which is why there was no need to use other weapons on recon ships.[/i]

[b]‘Draccar’ nanobot colony[/b]
[list]
[*] Damage increased by 10%.
[*] The duration of the nanobot colony has been reduced from 3 to 2 seconds.
[/list][i]Comment: these changes are designed to equate the weapon in efficiency with its analogue — Tai’thaq.[/i]

[b]Crystal drone (for fighters)[/b]
[list]
[*] Speed increased by 30%;
[*] Rate of fire increased by 2 times;
[*] Damage per shot reduced by 2 times; 
[*] Projectile speed has been increased to 3500 m/s.
[/list][i]Comment: at the moment, the module shows low efficiency, so these changes are aimed at improving the convenience of its use.[/i]

[hr][/hr][h2]Special modules[/h2]

[b]Wormhole stabilizer[/b]
[list]
[*] The wormhole is now displayed in the interface. 
[/list][i]Comment: this change will greatly simplify the reuse of wormholes, since sometimes there were difficulties with finding them. [/i]

[b]Artillery beam disintegrator[/b]
[list]
[*] The rotation speed of the special module gun during firing has been increased by 75%.
[/list][i]Comment: this special module is uncompetitive due to the need for docking, the absence of instant damage, as well as low damage compared to the standard disintegrator, and therefore this change is designed to simplify firing at ships smaller than a frigate.[/i]

[b]Mass defence system[/b]
[list]
[*] Modulecooldown is reduced from 30 to 25 seconds.
[/list][i]Comment: due to the mechanics of the operation, the module’s cooldown was too long.[/i]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the ship to be destroyed by remaining damage if the shield was turned off due to lack of energy.
[/list]
[b]Warp-reflector[/b]
[list]
[*] Shield recovery increased from 4000 to 6500 pts; 
[*] Passively increases the shield’s resistance to all types of damage by 20 pts. 
[/list][i]Comment: the number of shield points that can be restored turned out to be small for the Jericho destroyer, considering the necessary conditions for its effective usage, therefore, this change, together with an increase in the resistance of the shield, is aimed at strengthening the special module.[/i]

[b]Raid Diffusion Shield, Tech Diffusion Shield [/b]
[list]
[*] Cooldown reduced from 40 to 35 seconds.
[/list][i]Comment: often the increased recharge rate of the special module turned out to be more beneficial compared to other options.[/i]

[b]Vanguard ODG “Chameleon” [/b]
[list]
[*] Now, after exiting invisibility, the damage increases by 10% for 5 seconds. 
[/list][i]Comment: this edit will increase the relevance of Jaguar with this special module in comparison with Singularity.[/i]

[b]Repair drones (Mole)[/b]
[list]
[*] The preparation time for drone activation has been reduced from 30 to 20 seconds.
[/list][i]Comment: these drones are not designed for combat and only increase the survivability of ships, while being effective mainly on interceptors and attack aircraft, so this edit is aimed at improving the experience of using drones, allowing them to be used on a larger number of targets. [/i]

[b]Weapon systems sabotage[/b]
[list]
[*] Damage increased from 850 to 1500 pts./s;
[*] Active time has been increased from 6 to 8 seconds;
[*] Now the rotation of the enemy’s weapon is blocked while the module is active.
[/list][i]Comment: this special module had extremely low damage, that’s why many ships often ignored it.[/i]

[b]Reflecting shield[/b]
[list]
[*] Now restores 500 pts./sec. of the shield while the special module is active;
[*] The number of charges has been increased to 15.
[/list][i]Comment: these edits will increase the efficiency of using this special module in comparison with the Router. [/i]

[b]Beam destructor[/b]
[list]
[*] The amount of drained energy has been increased by 100 pts./s for regular ships and to 500 pts./s for destroyers.
[*] Now passively increases the hull’s resistance to all types of damage by 20 pts.  
[/list]
[b]Green mist[/b]
[list]
[*] Cooldown time reduced to 12 seconds.
[/list][i]Comment: the last edit of this special module was aimed at reducing the effectiveness of synergy with the “Gravi-Wave” module, capable of replenishing the charges of the special module. So now, when this is no longer relevant, it was decided to return the cooldown time back, while leaving the preparation time as it used to be.[/i]

[b]Crystalline swarm[/b]
[list]
[*] Turret mode: now increases resistance to all types of damage by 10 pts.
[*] Turret mode: projectile rotation increased to 12 gon/s (now about 10), damage reduced by 400.
[/list][i]Comment: these changes are designed to increase the effectiveness of these modes.[/i]

[b]Balanced swarm[/b]
[list]
[*] Attack mode, hunting mode: increases resistance to all types of damage by 10 pts.
[/list][i]Comment: this edit is intended to increase the effectiveness of this mode. [/i]

[b]All the swarms of Ellydium[/b]
[list]
[*] Reduced the coefficient of explosive damage received by the swarm.
[/list][i]Comment: this change is aimed at increasing the survival rate of the swarm against projectiles with explosive damage.[/i]

[b]Crystal Hunger[/b]
[list]
[*] Now the description considers the last repairing tick; 
[*] The amount of the restored hull pts. has been increased to 4500.
[/list][b]Hive[/b]
[list]
[*] Now the cooldown time of the special module depends on the rank of the ship:[list]
[*] Ranks 7-8 — 35 seconds;
[*] Ranks 9-10 — 34 seconds;
[*] Ranks 11-12 — 33 seconds;
[*] Ranks 13-14 — 32 seconds;
[*] Rank 15 — 30 seconds.
[/list][/list][i]Comment: these changes are designed to reduce the effectiveness of the special module at the minimum ranks of the ship.[/i]

[b]Combat reconstructor[/b]
[list]
[*] Now the module’s cooldown time depends on the rank of the ship:[list]
[*] Ranks 9-10 — 40 seconds;
[*] Ranks 11-12 — 38 seconds;
[*] Ranks 13-14 — 36 seconds;
[*] Rank 15 — 35 seconds.
[/list][/list][i]Comment: these changes are designed to reduce the effectiveness of the special module at the minimum ranks of the ship.[/i]

[b]Scavenger drones[/b]
[list]
[*] The drone’s flight speed has been increased to 1500 m/s.
[/list][i]Comment: this edit is aimed at increasing the effectiveness of the special module, as well as improving the experience of its use.[/i]

[b]Quantum leap[/b]
[list]
[*] Energy consumption at all levels of improvement has been increased by 100 units/s.
[/list][i]Comment: this special module showed overestimated efficiency, so this change is aimed at weakening it. [/i]

[b]Jump crystals[/b]
[list]
[*] The charge preparation time has been reduced to 25 seconds.
[/list]
[hr][/hr][h2]Active modules[/h2]

[b]Hazardous veil[/b]
[list]
[*] The duration has been reduced from 15 to 10 seconds.
[/list][i]Comment: this module could prevent the enemy from capturing the beacon for a very long time, while having a relatively fast cooldown time.[/i]

[b]Mail drone beacon[/b]
[list]
[*] “Ion diffuser” no longer destroys the mail drone.
[/list][i]Comment: the use of this module with such a long recharge was too easily interrupted by an AI-controlled enemy in the open world, where there are quite a lot of enemy ECM interceptors.[/i]

[b]Sniper drone ‘Partner’[/b]
[list]
[*] The penalty to the hull resistance has been reduced from 75 to 50 pts.
[/list][i]Comment: this edit is designed to reduce the risk of using the module when the drone does not provide adequate protection compared to the received penalties.[/i]

[b]Autonomous repair station. Autonomous charging station [/b]
[list]
[*] The cooldown at all levels of improvement has been reduced by 5 seconds.
[/list]
[b]Satellite crystal[/b]
[list]
[*] Maximum distance reduced to 1600 m;
[*] Speed increased to 550 m/s.
[/list][i]Comment: these changes will reduce the effective distance of the module, forcing the interceptor to stay at a closer distance to the target.[/i]

[b]Crystalline suppressor[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the main charge to not hit the target.
[/list]
[b]Waz'Got battle station[/b]
[list]
[*] Plasma turrets: projectile speed increased to 3000 m/s; 
[/list][i]Comment: this edit is aimed at increasing the effectiveness of this improvement option.[/i]
[list]
[*] Induction charger: energy recovery increased to 125 unnits/s. 
[/list]
[b]Autonomous battle station[/b]
[list]
[*] The flight speed of missile turrets has been increased to 2000 m/s.
[/list][i]Comment: Similar to the Waz’Got battle station, this edit is aimed at improving the effectiveness of defensive weapons.[/i]

[b]Main caliber[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the second shell in the volley to not hit the target.
[/list]
[b]Hull converter[/b]
[list]
[*] Now the maneuverability penalty is not affected by implants and modifiers;
[*] Now the module repairs 2 pts. of an ally’s hull for each point of reduced durability of its hull. 
[/list][i]Comment: these changes will increase the module’s efficiency, increasing its relevance compared to other restoration modules.[/i]

[b]Energy emitter[/b]
[list]
[*] The amount of energy recovered when the module is activated is increased by 2 times. 
[/list][i]Comment: this change will help to better cope with the negative effects of ECM modules.[/i]

[b]Infobarrier[/b]
[list]
[*] The working time has been increased to 15 seconds.
[/list][i]Comment: this change is intended to increase the efficiency of the module due to the possibility of its longer use.[/i]

[b]Alien intuition[/b]
[list]
[*] Now the energy consumption during activation depends on the rank of the ship:[list]
[*] Ranks 3-7 — 175 pts;
[*] Ranks 6-10 — 195 pts;
[*] Ranks 9-13 — 220 pts;
[*] Ranks 12-17 — 250 pts.
[/list][/list][i]Comment: this module showed excessive efficiency, so these changes are aimed at increasing the cost of its activation.[/i]

[b]Wormhole projector, Jump system “Kapkan” and Teleportation sphere[/b]
[list]
[*] Now, when one of these modules/modifier is activated, the others start to reload.
[/list]
[b]Hologram crystal, Phase Modulator[/b]
[list]
[*] Now, when one of these modules is activated, the other starts to reload.
[/list]
[b]Nano-devourers[/b]
[list]
[*] The restoration time decreased by 2 times (to 3 seconds);
[*] The restoration rate increased by 2 times;
[*] Now the restoration affects all the allies within its effective range;
[*] Reloading time decreased from 41 to 35 seconds.
[/list][i]Comment: the module provided too little support to the team due to specifics of its mechanics.[/i]

[hr][/hr][h2]Modifiers[/h2]

[b]Reserve shield system[/b]
[list]
[*] Now the activation of the modifier is accompanied by a visual effect; 
[/list][i]Comment: these changes are designed to increase the visibility of the modifier.[/i]

[b]“Echidna” processor[/b]
[list]
[*] Speed threshold increased to 35%. 
[/list][i]Comment: this change is aimed at increasing the permissible mobility of the ship for the effective use of the modifier.[/i]

[b]Iridium heatsink and Shared cooler[/b]
[list]
[*] Minimum rank reduced to 8.
[/list][i]Comment: this edit is designed to increase the coverage of ships optimal for the game on these ranks, as well as to increase the effectiveness of rank 8 suppression destroyers.[/i]

[b]Multipurpose shield[/b]
[list]
[*] The shield volume bonus has been increased from 17.5% to 25% (for rank 17, Mk.4).
[/list][i]Comment: this edit is intended to increase the efficiency of using the modifier.[/i]

[b]“Second Wind” repair kit[/b]
[list]
[*] Now the amount of hull restored increases with upgrade;
[/list][i]Comment: this change is intended to increase the efficiency of upgrading the module above Mk.3.[/i]

[b]Combat control[/b]
[list]
[*] Rate of fire increased by 2 times.
[/list][i]Comment: this edit is designed to increase the damage dealt by the modifier, increasing its effectiveness. [/i]

[b]Speed balancer[/b]
[list]
[*] The activation threshold has been increased to 30%. 
[/list][i]Comment: this change is intended to significantly simplify the use of the modifier on all ships other than Ze’ta.[/i]

[b]Descriptions[/b]
[list]
[*] Energy-compensating projectile
[*] Now the explosion radius and the projectile flight speed are indicated in the characteristics. 
[/list]
[b]IR Flares[/b]
[list]
[*] Now the range of the module is indicated in characteristics; 
[*] Now the description indicates which missiles are affected by the module.
[/list]
[b]Combat engineer drones and similar special modules [/b]
[list]
[*] An indication of drone preparation similar to Waz’got special modules has been added. 
[/list]
[b]Archangel[/b]
[list]
[*] Now the characteristics indicate the speed of flight and rotation of missiles.
[/list]
[b]Mass Propulsion Inhibitor[/b]
[list]
[*] Now the description states that it blocks the afterburner (not the boosters).
[/list]
[b]Albireo interceptor camouflage system [/b]
[list]
[*] Now the power consumption of the module is indicated in the characteristics. 
[/list]
[b]Artillery beam disintegrator [/b]
[list]
[*] Now the characteristics indicate the fire rate. 
[/list]
[b]Masking station[/b]
[list]
[*] Now the characteristics indicate the durability of the station.
[/list]
[b]MIRV launcher[/b]
[list]
[*] Now the characteristics indicate the damage and range of independent segments.
[/list]
[b]MiG-105[/b]
[list]
[*] Now the description features the interceptor’s characteristics.
[/list]
[hr][/hr][h2]Miscellaneous[/h2]

[b]Pirate ammunition [/b]
[list]
[*] The amount of resources required for production has been reduced by half. 
[/list]
[b]Passive regeneration of the Thar’ga hull [/b]
[list]
[*] The amount of the restored hull has been increased to 200 pts/s; 
[/list]
[b]Passive regeneration of the Waz’Got hull[/b]
[list]
[*] The amount of the restored hull has been increased to 300 pts/s;

[b]Raven[/b]
[list]
[*] An increase in the shield’s resistance to all damage by 10 units has been added to a number of initial ship bonuses.
[/list][i]Comment: this bonus is present in the vast majority of manufactured ships.[/i]

[b]Ships with landing ability[/b]
[list]
[*] Now, when the ship is in the landed state, it can launch homing missiles. 
[/list][i]Comment: this change is aimed at improving the experience of using homing missiles on the ships that are in landing mode. [/i]

[b]Empire Destroyers [/b]
[list]
[*] The hull’s resistance to all damage increased by 20 pts.
[/list][i]Comment: this change will allow the Empire destroyers to survive better in battle. [/i]

[b]Changed the ranks of the following equipment:[/b]
[list]
[*] Guided thermosphere — 12-17
[*] Branching laser — 9-13
[*] Eradicator X — 10-15
[*] Destabilising mortar — 8-12
[*] “Draccar” nanobot colony — 10-15
[*] Active screen — 10-15
[*] Sensor DDoS — 8-12
[*] “Prometheus” defence — 8-12
[*] Repelling shield — 8-12
[*] Mass charge accelerator — 10-15
[*] Explosive restoration — 4-9
[*] “Pendulum” — 8-12
[*] Active missile shield — 10-15
[*] “Sinobi” jump — 11-15
[*] Balanced defence — 11-15
[*] Dual shields — 11-15
[*] Thermoprojector — 11-15
[*] Neutron emitter — 8-13
[/list][i]Comment: these changes are aimed at increasing the relevance of premium ships.[/i]

[b]AI-controlled enemy[/b]
[list]
[*] Now Front blaster, Geyser and Bow EM laser won’t be installed on AI-controlled ships.
[/list][i]Comment: this weapon showed extremely low efficiency on AI-controlled ships. [/i]

[b]Sector Conquest[/b]
[list]
[*] “Destroyed Station” location is available for conquest again.

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug in the designation of some key elements in PvE.

notes.title: Star Conflict 1.11.1 Legacy. Stage two
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459272/a26a03ba058de3fa0557fb44554c8e8f235a14dc.jpg[/img]

The universe is full of mysteries and secrets. Knowledge is not always power. Sometimes ignorance is a blessing.

[quote]… it was the data provided by a certain Dr. Le Vasseur, who was taken out by us from Artuga last year. As we can see, the data directly indicates to us the connection between the Signal and the activity of Aliens. Previously, we suspected that the so-called Aliens — all these Crystallides and even Bions — are all of artificial origin. Now it is known for sure from the received data. All of them were created by the so-called Precursors. It is curious that Le Vasseur is certain, and I’m inclined to his opinion, that the war with Aliens is not a war of Strangers with people, but a war of Bions and Crystallides. And we just happened to be in the wrong place at the wrong time. And the purpose of this war is to find the source of the Signal, or those who created it and turned it on...[/quote][i]Excerpts from the memorandum Dr. Parks prepared for the annual meeting of directors of the Federation corporations in the fringe sectors.[/i]

[b]Star Conflict 1.11.1 Legacy. Stage two is already here![/b]

[b]In this update:[/b]
[list]
[*] Second stage of the "Legacy" event
[*] Empire rank 17 gunship “Typhon”
[*] Celebration of Star Conflict and Targem Games anniversary!
[*] New temporary packs in the game store!
[*] Balancing changes
[/list]
[h2][url=https://star-conflict.com/en/news/2866/current]Read more on our website.[/url][/h2]

Not so long ago, in the “Ice pits” location of the Olympus system, new extremely unusual ships were seen, as if frozen in ice. It turned out that these were the secret laboratories developments of the private corporation Klauss Inc. An experimental prototype to test the latest technology.

It was rumored that the improved version of the frigate “Grizzly”, being developed in the conditions of harsh and cold space, was initially not supposed to tolerate external changes. As the designers themselves said, their task was to improve the combat characteristics at any cost. Due to the difficult working conditions in the “Ice pits” location, during development the ship began to be covered with a unique crystalline-iridium crust, similar to the one mined in the Alpha-7 sector. Extremely low temperatures, close to absolute zero, made it possible to use this in favor of the ship - the “Ice” formed on the ship significantly added combat power and armor. In addition, interaction with iridium in such conditions can change the course of the battle in its own direction - the ship can direct its “ice” power at enemies!

Miss Frost, one of the most trusted representatives of Klauss Inc., invites pilots to independently test the latest development and take part in tests. The ship has temporarily become available for purchase to all mercenaries in the border sectors. And the obtained data will help in improving the weapons and ships of the corporation. 

The first one who volunteered to test the ship was one of the people close to Miss Frost, the battalion commander of “Klauss Inc.”, also known as “General Frost”. This pilot will always find an approach to the cold, and finding it to the ice ship is no problem for him! According to test results, the General liked the ship so much that he personally ordered a batch of ships for his fighters, seeking to create a real, “Ice” army.

Only today, on November 23, UMC offers a 30% discount on parts for the “Executor” ship! The parts can be purchased directly from the ship tree.

The Family Council is hardly ever enraged, but if you fell into their disgrace, be prepared to see one of the executioners on your radar, who will carry out the sentence. The progressive minds of Jericho designed the Executor for these people.

The sentence passed by the Council of Families is most often a death penalty, and none of the convicts seeks to meet the executioner. Therefore, the ship is equipped in such a way as to overtake the criminal, slow him down, stretch out the moment of agony and realization of what he had done, give him a couple of seconds to repent as a gesture of mercy and then — quickly hit him with torpedoes.

The special offer is valid for a limited time and will end on November 24!

Sincerely,
Star Conflict Team

In the past, it was the Imperial mining ship “Digger”. It’s not known for certain who was involved in the modernization and transformation of the frigate. The survivors of the Doomed Flotilla were rumoured to have had a hand in this by trying to escape from the infected sectors. The ship’s old hull was badly damaged, and so it became the carcass on which the new plating from various scrap metals was attached. Somebody thought it would be a good idea to use some of the metal to create a fearsome look for the frigate.

Thrasher was seen as part of a small group of Butchers under the command of Graml Rusty. Soon, the mercenaries destroyed the thugs involved in the destruction of cargo ships. The unusual frigate was captured with almost no damage and taken to UMC. At the request of the mercenaries, Thrasher was studied by the qualified engineers. In a short time, a version of the engineering frigate was developed based on this prototype. Despite the appearance remaining the same, Thrasher has seriously changed. What was once scrap metal has been replaced by superior armor and the power system has been brought up to the standards of modern engineering ships. The ship also received new weapons developed at the UMC.

Thrasher is currently being manufactured in single units at the UMC shipyards on special order. It is very likely that the ships could appear in the service of pirates, involved in the purchase of ships through proxies.

notes.title: Halloween in Space. Space Cult
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459272/43091344e783ac3e639b95425687d45f196e3668.jpg[/img]

Every year at the end of October in the Earth’s calendar, a wave of anomalous energy passes through the Universe. This period is called Halloween according to an old Earth tradition. This year, specifically for the event, we are introducing a new mysterious ship!

[h2]Space Cult [/h2]
Scary times are coming, mercenary! The "Peak of the Signal" has come and the Dark Forces are trying to destroy Humanity! Recently, our brotherhood has discovered the increased activity of the cult "Yith'got Witnesses". At the moment, they are rapidly recruiting new novices. I need your help as an embedded agent. Together we will purify their souls, polluted by green trash!

Available to all pilots in the “Events” tab.

[h2]“W.I.T.Ch. Hunt” protocol![/h2]

Fanatics and cultists who worship the Signal believe that the souls of the dead come to our world on Halloween.

Previously, scientists explained this phenomenon by the fact that it was at this time that the Signal reached its peak. Every year countless laboratories conduct daring experiments to tame the energy of the Signal. A few years ago, one such project of Jericho ended in disaster. After that, all objects with an active signal were assigned the code name W.I.T.Ch.

The protocol “W.I.T.Ch. Hunt” is now active Mercenaries can earn special rewards for destroying W.I.T.Ches!

UMC dug up special long-discontinued weapons in warehouses. Only these weapons are guaranteed to protect mercenaries from the Infected. Using missiles “MEM Inquisitor”, you must destroy the ships of those mercenaries who are suspected of carrying the alien infection. Infected are among all combat roles — you need to destroy at least one host from each role.
The best mercenaries will get a special achievement and a special title!

[h2]Miranda Del Arte’s Special Tasks[/h2]
The “New Day’s Signal” Brotherhood reminds you: “Signal’s Peak” is approaching: it’s a troubled time, when the spirits of the dead come to collect their tribute from the living! Miranda Del Arte offers new special assignments for mercenaries!

[h2]Scary sounds![/h2]
Some pilots report hearing extremely spooky sounds and demonic laughter when docking with stations. Perhaps this is somehow connected with the W.I.T.Ch. operation. We managed to intercept and record one of these messages:

[h2]“Detonation” mode[/h2]
The Center has received alarming reports that special bombs in the PvP mode “Detonation” look extremely suspicious! We urge all pilots to be as attentive as possible in these dangerous times.

[h2]Strange faces[/h2]
Some employees of the UMC as well as employees of intelligence representatives and corporations that are actively working with mercenaries, have been looking extremely strange and suspicious recently. Perhaps this is somehow related to Signal’s peak. But it is also possible that these are just festive costumes.

[h2]Brawl marathon “Curse of the Leviathan”[/h2]

Attention all pilots! The UMC received an emergency contract from the so-called Broker.

[list]
[*] All mercenaries who took places from 1 to 3 in the leaderboards of researchers or infected in the “Curse of the Leviathan” brawl recorded by UMC engineers on November 10 will receive the unique pattern “Curse of leviathan” which can only be obtained during this event, 500 xenocrystals and 1000 GS.
[*] All pilots who took places from 4th to 10th in the leaderboards of researchers and infected in the “Curse of the Leviathan” brawl recorded by the UMC engineers on November 10, will receive 500 xenocrystals.
[*] All pilots who took places from 10 to 20 in the leaderboards of researchers and infected in the “Curse of the Leviathan” brawl recorded by UMC engineers on November 10 will receive 300 xenocrystals.
[/list]

It is said that it was previously one of the Sentinels' ships. A mysterious association of artificial intelligences left after the disappearance of the Techs. The objectives of the Sentinels are unclear. According to one version, the Techs left them to keep an eye on the secrets of Jericho, which they could not take with them. According to the other, the Techs have finally merged with their machines in order not to fall under the influence of the biomorph virus, and now they live a “digital” life.

One of their ships was part of an ill-fated expedition to the ominous Leviathan, where the signatures were recorded similar to those recorded in the notorious Monolith. No one of that expedition returned back. Only the Sentinel ship escaped. Unrecognizably changed. As after a serious illness. The transformation affected not only his appearance, but also his capabilities. And his AI began to respond to the call sign “Plague Doctor”. He looks for the infected everywhere and treats them as he considers right - by death.

A unique feature of this ship is the ability to infect ships. If a hostile ship contacted its other allies, then the infection spreads to them as well.

notes.title: Eight years since the game’s release! Golden battles!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459272/b1e02d41422f12b9e7aca87dcd8a39c84f4b1213.jpg[/img]

Eight years ago, on September 4, 2014, Star Conflict was officially released. Since then, the world of the project has changed significantly. For eight years, pilots have been fighting each other in PvP battles, completing tasks in PvE missions, and exploring Open Space.

During this time, new attack aircraft, frigates, and destroyers were involved. There are new weapons, new modules and new locations that have been opened.

Over the past year, the pilots took part in a lot of interesting events. The year began with a new unusual brawl “Close Encounter”, which you played while constructing a new long-range frigate of Jericho — Protazan. Horrors followed into space with the already familiar “Curse of the Leviathan” brawl and Naglfar’s frightening frigate ghost! During the year, many ships have been changed and improved — Shark, Joker, Razor and Blood Tormentor moved to the highest ranks. The federation presented its pride — the rank 17 destroyer Albireo, along with this, the pilots unraveled new mysteries of the universe and then embarked on the path of a warrior, receiving a unique rank 17 command attack aircraft Kirishima. By the way, did everyone find the Cookie astronaut in space? He sends his regards to you! And recently, the pilots got closer to the dark secrets, again studying the history of Larry Seldon and the mysterious fragments, simultaneously receiving a brand new covert ops ship Kusarigama in the hangar.

Thank you for being with us and conquering the universe for another year!

The new year will bring us new surprises. And today we have a holiday! Festive rockets “Spark” are available for purchase from 2 to 7 of September!

[h1]The UMC announces the Golden Battles! [/h1]

Pilots! The UMC announces the “Golden Battles”! Each pilot can earn up to 500 Galactic Standards for winning.

Until 04:00 GMT on September 5, participants will receive the following rewards:

[list]
[*] 50 Galactic Standards for 5 victories
[*] 100 Galactic Standards for 10 victories
[*] 150 Galactic Standards for 15 victories
[*] 200 Galactic Standards for 20 victories
[/list]

Good luck in the battles, mercenaries!

Best regards,
Star Conflict Team

Special bonus for everyone who buys the bundle — Premium license for 90 days!

[h2]Star Conflict: Kusarigama[/h2]

This pack includes:
[list]
[*] Jericho covert ops interceptor Kusarigama. Rank 17
[*] Shrapnel cannon “Punisher”
[*] Active module “Plasma Ram”
[*] Unique character portrait “Celia Casado”
[/list]

Special bonus for everyone who buys the bundle — Premium license for 30 days!

Kusarigama is the newest cover ops ship of the Liu family that was built at the Crystal shipyard. Rumour has it that the technologies from the Temple of Last Hope were used in its creation, although this hasn’t been confirmed. Due to the production limitations, the interceptors are produced one at a time, and for specific tasks that are unknown to anyone. Occasionally this AI-controlled ship can often be encountered in the Jericho sectors.

One of the Kusarigama’s main advantages is the Avionics-K onboard electronic complex, designed specifically for the new interceptor. In many ways, it is because of this system that the ship has great efficiency. The shrapnel kinetic weapon, common for Jericho ships, has been significantly redesigned and enhanced, and the active and special modules allow the pilot to destroy the full range of possible targets.

So far, neither the Sentinels nor the Mendes family have been able to obtain the blueprints of Kusarigama for further research and production. According to the Liu Family, in the future it is planned to supply the UMC with a weakened version of the Kusarigama for testing by mercenaries.

Phoenix is another marvel of pirate engineers. Initially it used to be a Styx, though proving it seems to be rather impossible. The first ships began attacking Imperial convoys in 4611. The heavily-armed frigate was capable of fighting against transport escorts with ease, while simultaneously carrying out field repairs for allied forces. According to the Sargas Fund, more than a hundred convoys were destroyed with the help of the Phoenix frigates.

Despite all positive qualities of the ship, the Legion forces have easily managed to capture a few prototypes for further research. As it turned out later, Phoenix was equipped with non-standard engines and an improved power supply system, operating on the verge of overloading at all times. The ship’s hull also received additional armor. Among other things, the ship has many combat modules of federal origin. Separately, it is worth noting the ship’s extended bridge, which was the reason why many collectors bought the frigate.

The ship’s blueprints, created based on the results of the research, were transferred to the UMC. Despite its high cost, many mercenaries gladly purchase Phoenix to take part in heavy combat. However, the leadership of the Center does not recommend flying this frigate in Imperial space, as these machines used to lead the largest pirate raids, and are associated with pirate leaders. This fact gives the Imperial forces the right to destroy the ship at the slightest suspicion of any illegal activity.

In 4622 the ship was significantly enhanced and the already issued Phoenix are now being modernized. The new auto-repair system is rumored to be able to get the ship back in service even when the hull is severely damaged, as long as vital on-board equipment remains operational.

The only obvious conclusion that can be drawn about this ship is that it is a modification of “Tormentor”. For a long time, ships of the “Blood Tormentor” type were involved in attacks on convoys, until the Raid destroyed a group of marauders using this guard frigate. That’s when the Techcs received its first samples for examination.

A detailed study revealed the use of non-standard energy sources and a turbo-cooling system. The shield generator has also received a number of artisanal modifications. The blueprints based on the examined frigates were handed over to the UMC, but during the transport of the documentation, a number of data blocks were captured by the Enclave. The Mercenary Center engineers managed to establish a single-unit production of the ships for an additional fee, and the Enclave launched a streaming production of “Blood Tormentor” for their army.

In 4622, the UMC decided to modify “Blood Tormentor” due to the appearance of numerous new strike ships and destroyers. The onboard electronic equipment has been completely replaced. The frigate’s shields have received major improvements, and its important components have been reinforced with composite armor.
The mercenary ships are currently undergoing a planned cost-free modernization and the shipyards are preparing for the release of the renewed project. Because of the numerous improvements, it was decided to increase the ship’s technical rank.

Their affiliation to any pirate group has never been confirmed. Jericho forces soon attempted to capture several fighters for research. As a result of the special operation, many ships were captured undamaged.

An unusual cooling system was discovered while examining Sawtooth, that significantly increases the efficiency of the ship’s systems. The artisanal engines installed on the fighters were slightly different from each other, but a general tendency of increasing the fighter’s speed by consuming more fuel was apparent. It was impossible to recognize the original model of the ship.

After studying all the features of Sawtooth, the Techs were able to create refined blueprints of the fighter. It was decided to hand over the blueprints to the UMC so that the mercenaries could test the tackler. The engineers considered the impressive exterior and huge bow ram to be too important attributes to be changed, so they reproduced this model with the utmost precision. The Raid Command praised the promising development, and the fighters began to join the elite units. According to rumors, Razor pilots try not to expose their ship to enemy fire and are constantly improving their maneuvering skills. The Tackler has become a real hunter for pirate and Cyber ships.

notes.title: Star Conflict 1.10 Mysteries of the Universe. Stage one
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459272/f11bc7d7d0b4edad90eabfb02ad819766035f10f.jpg[/img]

The universe is full of secrets and mysteries. The unknown and the uncharted... It surrounds us from all sides... And the most mysterious thing in the universe is the secret to the origins of life. Where did we come from? Are we alone in the universe?

We know the answer. In the Star Conflict universe, which we have been exploring with you for almost ten years, we are not alone. There are at least two other intelligent races - Crystallids and Bions, which we call Aliens for short.

After the war with the Aliens, the world lies in ruins. Millions of refugees are struggling to survive among the ruins of the old world. Old states have disappeared. The new ones are too weak. But the war goes on. Survivors fight each other in an attempt to master all the mysteries of the Universe. And this war is just beginning…

notes.title: Star Conflict 1.9.3 Halloween in Space
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459272/5394bb217716a536e8c0a1a2ac965a0e4e7d4cb0.jpg[/img]

Every year at the end of October in the Earth’s calendar, a wave of anomalous energy passes through the Universe. This period is called Halloween according to an old Earth tradition. This year, specifically for the event, we are introducing a new mysterious ship!

[h1]Rank 16 Jericho guard frigate “Naglfar”.[/h1]
[previewyoutube=oV_1zTTt48k;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]
Naglfar is a miracle of the Sentinels. Supposedly, such ships were designed for the expedition to sector 1337. Soon after, they disappeared.

Among the mercenaries, it is rumored that a single ship of this kind caused the destruction of an entire UMC station. It returned from the expedition defiled, as if it itself had become an artifact of the Precursors. The people around the artifact were going insane. They were killing themselves to end the suffering.

One mercenary met the Sentinel and survived. He called him Naglfar and became a faithful comrade to him. Since then, other ships of this kind have begun to emerge. Fearless mercenaries are not afraid of rumors and make contact with the ships. Perhaps their minds are also protected from ancient curses.

[h2]New DLC bundles “Star Conflict: Naglfar. Deluxe edition” and “Star Conflict: Naglfar”[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459272/e091f1fe191d041ba759d5be73ffe4284dfd48a3.jpg[/img]

The bundles will be available for purchase until November 25. There are no restrictions on using the “Naglfar” ship in the game.[/url]

[b]This pack includes[/b]
[list]
[*] Rank 16 Jericho guard frigate “Naglfar”.

[h1]Halloween in Space[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459272/f32342b9a15e72ba4e70e15fe5be398f6a307366.jpg[/img]

Fanatics and cultists who worship the Signal believe that the souls of the dead come to our world on Halloween.

Previously, scientists explained this phenomenon by the fact that it was at this time that the Signal reached its peak. Every year countless laboratories conduct daring experiments to tame the energy of the Signal. A few years ago, one such project of Jericho ended in disaster. After that, all objects with an active signal were assigned the code name W.I.T.Ch.

The protocol “W.I.T.Ch. Hunt” is now active Mercenaries can earn special rewards for destroying W.I.T.Ches!

[h2]“W.I.T.Ch. Hunt” protocol![/h2]
UMC dug up special long-discontinued weapons in warehouses. Only these weapons are guaranteed to protect mercenaries from the Infected. Using missiles “MEM Inquisitor”, you must destroy the ships of those mercenaries who are suspected of carrying the alien infection. Infected are among all combat roles — you need to destroy at least one host from each role.
The best mercenaries will get a special achievement and a special title!

[h2]Miranda Del Arte’s Special Tasks
[/h2]
The “New Day’s Signal” Brotherhood reminds you: “Signal’s Peak” is approaching: it’s a troubled time, when the spirits of the dead come to collect their tribute from the living! Miranda Del Arte offers new special assignments for mercenaries!

[h2]Scary sounds![/h2]
Some pilots report hearing extremely spooky sounds and demonic laughter when docking with stations. Perhaps this is somehow connected with the W.I.T.Ch. operation. We managed to intercept and record one of these messages

[h2]“Detonation” mode[/h2]
The Center has received alarming reports that special bombs in the PvP mode “Detonation” look extremely suspicious! We urge all pilots to be as attentive as possible in these dangerous times.

[h2]Strange faces[/h2]
Some employees of the UMC as well as employees of intelligence representatives and corporations that are actively working with mercenaries, have been looking extremely strange and suspicious recently. Perhaps this is somehow related to Signal’s peak. But it is also possible that these are just festive costumes.

[h1]The brawl “Curse of the Leviathan”[/h1]
Until recently, no one dared to approach the infected, until signatures similar to those recorded in the infamous Monolith were periodically recorded in the old catacombs of Leviathan. Having given huge sums to the Broker, the unknown managed to set up a public contract for sending volunteers allegedly from Jericho “for reconnaissance” to the signatures of the infected. What those who have hired the Broker plan to do is known only to them, but no one can say for sure what awaits the mercenaries in the gloomy catacombs...

notes.title: Seven years since release! Gold Battles!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459272/0d2c2806441e1205ab76411b145610699b34181d.jpg[/img]

Seven years ago, on September 4, 2014 Star Conflict was officially released. Since then, the project’s world has changed significantly. For seven years pilots have been fighting each other in PvP, completing PvE missions, and exploring Open Space.

During this time, new fighters, frigates, and destroyers joined the lineup. New weapons and new modules were added. New locations were discovered.

Over the past year, pilots took part in a lot of interesting events. The seventh year after the release began with “Raven's Flight”; the “Raven” frigate proudly landed in the shipyard. Then our world was plunged into darkness and chaos — “Plague Doctor” and further experiments in “Leviathan” played a cruel joke, which the pirates took advantage of — our pilots will remember the Halloween “time travel” for a long time! This year has refreshed the competitive spirit with major seasonal events that are well rewarded with both in-game rewards and interesting stuff outside the game. The new rank 17 destroyers cannot be overlooked as well! Two of them are already conquering the vastness of space, but we are sure that the Federation will keep up with other factions. This year, we took a new look at space mining — a special “Mole” ship helped us do just that. And before that we were trying to solve the mystery of the cars appearing in space, while collecting parts for “Salyut-ST”. By the way, do you remember about the “Orion’s belt”? Three teams share one battlefield — this is a real spectacle. Thank you for being with us and conquering the universe for another year!

notes.title: Star Conflict 1.8.5 Asteroid conqueror
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459272/1f380b1487e2e46594b89d2e411f389012923860.png[/img]

Attention all pilots! UMC announces the start of the special event “Asteroid conqueror”! The event will last until May 26. Only during the event the pilots will be able to receive the “Mole” ship components when destroying asteroids in the “Open Space” mode.
Federation engineering frigate “Mole” rank 16
[previewyoutube=U78TMtjhq7o;full][/previewyoutube]
With the beginning of the Second Invasion, the UMC leadership decided to create a miner ship so that they would not have problems with resources in the future. A contract for the development was signed with Scott en Cott corporation. It was the Federation scientists who had to create a frigate.

At one stage of development, the CMS joined the project. After providing some equipment for Mole, the corporation ordered a large batch of ships, and then acquired a production license in a limited number.

Upon completion of all works, the first batches of ships were immediately handed over to the UMC. Currently, mercenaries can buy Mole directly from Scott en Cott corporation or through intermediaries at the Center. The corporation’s shipyards have already received large orders from various organizations and it is safe to say that Mole is one of Scott en Cott’s best projects, which allows to receive unprecedented profits.

[b]Emitter ML-V2[/b]
A mining laser. Increases the time during which an asteroid may exist at critical temperatures without exploding.

[b]Special module “Repair drones”[/b]
Gradually restore shields and hull of the owner. The drone can be sent to the selected ally. If the ship’s durability reaches critically low values, the drone activates emergency regeneration. The drone has no weapons.

[b]Mail drone beacon[/b]
The beacon was designed by UMC to send drones directly from the stations to the ship. The system allows you not to fear the possibility of drones being destroyed while waiting for cargo. Currently, many stations have received UMC installations for launching drones instead of the old ones.
[list]
[*] Calls the mail drone. To send the cargo, you need to press the interaction button.
[*] Players of the same squad can interact with the drone
[/list]

[b]Unique ship bonus:[/b]
[list]
[*] Extended range of resource gathering for the ship - 750 meters
[/list]

notes.title: Star Conflict 1.8.4 Cosmonautics Day!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459272/663a95a04ac4f007158fb9789bf7a927956a8b7f.png[/img]


We wish all our pilots a happy “Cosmonautics Day”! 60 years ago, the first manned flight into space took place. In honour of this event, information screens on space stations were updated and there are satellites instead of drones in space. Pilots can complete the special “Cosmonautics Day” achievement and take advantage of special holiday rockets.

[h1]New UMC interceptor ECM Salyut-ST[/h1]
[previewyoutube=7M8x-0H6tms;full][/previewyoutube]
[list]
[*] Affiliation: UMC
[*] Class: Interceptor
[*] Role: ECM
[*] Ranks: 5 - 15. Depending on the rank selected by the player, the number of available modules varies.
[/list]

Salyut-ST is another development from the Directorium times. However, unlike the proven Spiral and Endeavour, the ship was not mass-produced at the time and the project was frozen. The reason for this is the rather complex design, the offset centres of gravity and the complex alignment of the engines, which prevented that version of the ship from being able to fight with the known ships on equal terms. This ensured the fact that they were not involved in the battle with the “Fringe” fanatics.

The project received a second life during the second Invasion. In conditions of war and limited resources, it was necessary to adopt a fleet capable of fighting and disorienting the enemy without drawing attention. Salyut-ST executed this task perfectly. Despite the external similarities with objects of the first space conquest, the inner shell of the ship was equipped with the most modern equipment of the Imperial ECM ships, the armouring system was redesigned, and the engines were completely changed.

At the end of the Invasion, the blueprints of this model were kept secret for a long time. Now the ECM has decided to start an open development, and the collectors have already offered a handsome price for such a ship.

The pilot can activate and deactivate nodes in the skill tree. In this case:
[list]
[*] Ship rank changes.
[*] Ship’s parameters change.
[*] The set of modules, modifiers and available weapons changes as well.
[/list]

As its power increases and its rank changes, the ship will change externally - the availability of upgraded equipment transforms it from a museum piece into a modern spaceship!

[b]Special module[/b]
By upgrading the ship using the same system, you will gradually gain access to the ship’s unique special modules. Upon reaching a certain level, there will be three of them to choose from:

[list]
[*][b] EM wave generator “Faith”[/b] - The ship drains the energy from enemy ships in front of it and slows down the rotation of their weapons
[*] [b]EM wave generator “Hope”[/b] - The speed of the enemies in front of the ship is forcibly increased while their turning speed is reduced
[*] [b]EM wave generator “Love”[/b] - The work of the weapons and modules, that belong to the enemies in front of the ship, is disrupted. The weapons shoot at their allies, and the modules are disabled and cannot be activated.
[/list]

You can get the ship right now by completing in-game tasks for which you will receive xenochips. A unique bundle, containing special parts required for the production of the ship, has become available in the in-game store. In addition, the ship is already available as part of DLC bundles. At the end of the xenochips collection event, parts for the production of this ship can be bought or sold in the trade. 

The ship is also upgraded with special parts - Monocrystalline plates, which can be obtained by holding the sector in “Conquest” and “Portals” modes. They can also be studied in a workshop, dismantled into monocrystals or sold in trade.

notes.title: Star Conflict 1.8.2 Happy Universe Defender Day!
notes.notes:

Pilots! UMC wishes you a happy Universe Defender Day, a holiday traditionally celebrated in February. Protect the Universe from enemies, win and get rewards!

[previewyoutube=RkNME5EtbY4;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Festive brawl “Orion’s Belt”[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459272/710ac580f1cdb54e578f337cae87160fe7825cdd.jpg[/img]

A lot of time has passed since the opening of sectors in which, as mercenaries believe, there are traces of the Precursors. These are places that Dr. Pavlov himself considered one of the main secrets of ancient civilizations. Despite this, interest in the sectors is still not diminishing. Often everyone, from an ordinary mercenary to an influential factional figure, hopes to gain profit trying to find something valuable here. There are also followers of Pavlov's cause. Enthusiasts from all over the world are trying to find the unknown and expensive in the sectors, fighting for the opportunity to scan every asteroid.

Sometimes there are several expeditions in the fight for “possible” and “expensive” data, creating a real cross battlefield in which it is almost impossible to understand who belongs to your team and who is hostile.

The brawl is available every day until March 1. The rest of the brawls will be disabled for this time.
Players divided into three teams participate in the battle.
Players use their ships for battle.
When the ship is destroyed, you can take it an unlimited number of times.
Special points are given for destroying players of enemy teams.
The team that scored 30 points or destroyed more enemies in the given time wins.

[b]Players can earn new achievements for winning in the “Orion’s Belt” mode[/b]
[list]
[*] For 5 victories you can get the “Team player” achievement
[*] For 10 victories you can get the “Team’s hope” achievement
[*] For 40 victories you can get the “Dream teammate” achievement
[/list]

[h2]“Orion‘s Belt” brawl marathon[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459272/00cfe174825418fc868df640bd758f12cf869420.jpg[/img]

[b]Attention all pilots! The UMC received an emergency contract from the so-called Broker.
[/b]
[list]
[*] All mercenaries, who took places from 1 to 10 in the leaderboards recorded by UMC engineers on March 1, will get unique paint “Triangles”, 500 monocrystals and 1000 GS.
[*] All pilots who take places from 11 to 25 in the brawl leaderboards recorded by UMC engineers on March 1, will get 1000 GS.
[*] All pilots who took places from 26 to 40 in the leaderboards recorded by UMC engineers on March 1, will get 500 GS.
[/list]

[h1]Updated “tournament”[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459272/8dd5a12a6c39dc83ced499b704d08587c0644d01.jpg[/img]


Pilots! We are happy to present you an updated weekend tournament! Now the tournament will be held twice a week — this way, the players can know where and when the team battles will occur. The ranks allowed for the tournament will always be fixed — from 7 to 9 inclusive. Thus, a larger number of pilots will be able to participate in the tournament: both beginners and experienced mercenaries. 

[b]The mode was also changed from “beacon capture” to “team battle”.
[/b]
We also worked on the mechanics of team matching. Initially, teams will be assembled based on the personal qualities of each pilot. However, after the first battle, the team performance will also be taken into account. The opponent for this team will be selected according to the same parameters. For example, if your team performed well in the first battle, in the second battle you will fight against a team that performed approximately the same in the battle before.

How to participate in the tournament?
In the “Battle” tab, wait for the start of the “tournament” event, which is available on Saturday and Sunday at 16:00 GMT. If you successfully registered for the tournament, all your ships will be blocked until the end of the event.
[b]
Each team plays 3 battles. For each victory the reward of each participant increases:[/b]
[list]
[*] 1 victory - 150 gs
[*] 2 victories - 250 gs
[*] 3 victories - 400 gs

Not so long ago, in the “Ice pits” location of the Olympus system, new extremely unusual ships were seen, as if frozen in ice. It turned out that these were the secret laboratories developments of the private corporation Klauss Inc. An experimental prototype to test the latest technology.

It was rumored that the improved version of the frigate “Grizzly”, being developed in the conditions of harsh and cold space, was initially not supposed to tolerate external changes. As the designers themselves said, their task was to improve the combat characteristics at any cost. Due to the difficult working conditions in the “Ice pits” location, during development the ship began to be covered with a unique crystalline-iridium crust, similar to the one mined in the Alpha-7 sector. Extremely low temperatures, close to absolute zero, made it possible to use this in favor of the ship - the “Ice” formed on the ship significantly added combat power and armor. In addition, interaction with iridium in such conditions can change the course of the battle in its own direction - the ship can direct its “ice” power at enemies!

Miss Frost, one of the most trusted representatives of Klauss Inc., invites pilots to independently test the latest development and take part in tests. The ship has temporarily become available for purchase to all mercenaries in the border sectors. And the obtained data will help in improving the weapons and ships of the corporation. 

The first one who volunteered to test the ship was one of the people close to Miss Frost, the battalion commander of “Klauss Inc.”, also known as “General Frost”. This pilot will always find an approach to the cold, and finding it to the ice ship is no problem for him! According to test results, the General liked the ship so much that he personally ordered a batch of ships for his fighters, seeking to create a real, “Ice” army.

Pilots! The factions have begun a massive mobilization! Apparently, preparations are underway for war. The exact reasons for such a rapid build-up of power on each side are still unknown. The UMC implies that after the retreat of aliens, territorial conflicts again take place, however, the factions conduct the most hidden policy of their actions. It is only known that each of them recruits mercenaries to their side, because in war every fighter is important!

[previewyoutube=UlzwsZgd0fI;full][/previewyoutube]

In this regard, the UMC announces the start of a new event that will help the mercenaries increase their power and get the newest prototype of the Jericho rank 17 destroyer - Relic. This is the first of three high-ranking destroyers presented by factions for war on a new level. 

We recommend all pilots to be extremely vigilant about all incoming offers so as not to fall into the hands of space scammers who can use you in this war!

[h2]“Faction Wars” event[/h2]

Pilots, “Faction wars” will take place in two stages. There are 45 levels in each stage. Only the owners of a special Pass can unlock all levels. But every first and fifth level will be available to all pilots.

To get the reward, you need to unlock the desired level. In order to gain access to the next reward you need to go through all the previous stages. You can join a stage at any time when the stage is available.

The event will last for three months. During the entire period, all pilots will be able to earn special Xenochip game currency in battle.

[list]
[*] Xenochips can be obtained for completing any tasks as an additional reward.
[*] Xenochips are added to the game for a limited time, and after the end of the event they will be withdrawn from the game and from the accounts of all pilots. We recommend you to spend your xenochips before the end of the event!
[*] Xenochips can be spent on special rewards during the event.
[/list]

[b][url=https://star-conflict.com/en/news/2295-star-conflict-1-8-0-faction-wars-stage-one-en]Learn more on the official game site.[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459272/71bce877836834abd7bc77f3c819ab4b2d1cc74c.jpg[/img]

It is said that it was previously one of the Sentinels' ships. A mysterious association of artificial intelligences left after the disappearance of the Techs. The objectives of the Sentinels are unclear. According to one version, the Techs left them to keep an eye on the secrets of Jericho, which they could not take with them. According to the other, the Techs have finally merged with their machines in order not to fall under the influence of the biomorph virus, and now they live a “digital” life.

One of their ships was part of an ill-fated expedition to the ominous Leviathan, where the signatures were recorded similar to those recorded in the notorious Monolith. No one of that expedition returned back. Only the Sentinel ship escaped. Unrecognizably changed. As after a serious illness. The transformation affected not only his appearance, but also his capabilities. And his AI began to respond to the call sign “Plague Doctor”. He looks for the infected everywhere and treats them as he considers right - by death.

A unique feature of this ship is the ability to infect ships. If a hostile ship contacted its other allies, then the infection spreads to them as well.

[h2]New brawl “Curse of the Leviathan[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459272/9601294498a157b6f31569249dd4fe52eb1831d4.jpg[/img]

Until recently, no one dared to approach the infected, until signatures similar to those recorded in the infamous Monolith were periodically recorded in the old catacombs of Leviathan. Having given huge sums to the Broker, the unknown managed to set up a public contract for sending volunteers allegedly from Jericho “for reconnaissance” to the signatures of the infected. What those who have hired the Broker plan to do is known only to them, but no one can say for sure what awaits the mercenaries in the gloomy catacombs...

All players in the brawl start the battle on the same ships.

The brawl is available every day until November 16. The rest of the brawls will be disabled for this time.

The newest long-range frigate Gungnir just left Sparta shipyard. With excellent characteristics, it has become a great addition to the Imperial fleet.

As we know, Spartan scientists studied the ruins of the Warden outpost in the Felony system for a long time. It was the secret projects of the Order of Emperor that allowed them to complete the development in the shortest possible time. One of the features of Gungnir was the ability to land on various objects for the purpose of firing its disintegrator. This powerful weapon shoots at the target twice and leaves no chance of survival.

However, Sparta's generals decided that Gungnir was perfect for ground operations. Thus, separate detachments of frigates were sent to artillery units and used as heavy weapons to shell enemy fortifications.

Having carried out tests in real battles, Sparta sold blueprints to the UMC, and now mercenaries will be able to test the latest tech.

notes.notes:
Pilots! The new bundle “Star Conflict: Custodian” is now available in the [url=https://store.gaijin.net/story.php?id=7096]official store.[/url] 

Those pilots who received one or more parts of the Manual Piloting System during the Moon Race will get a special discount on the purchase of the Custodian DLC.
[list]
[*] The discount is bigger if you earned more parts of the “Manual Piloting System” during the race.

[/list]

[/list]

[list]
[*] Unique ship decoration “Jericho logo”
[*] Unique title “Custodian captain”
[*] Unique paint “Serpent”
[*] Sticker set Ursa Major, Terraformer, Space Walk 
[/list]
Special bonus for everyone who buys the bundle — Premium license for 30 days!

There have been many rumours about Technologists, the tech geniuses from Jericho. Only one thing can be said for sure — they're gone. Gone without a trace. Artificial intelligence remained after their exodus. It called himself the Sentinels and took control of the Jericho sector.

Although the Alien invasion was declining, their portals remained a problem, and the Sentinels assembled a special model of the ship to keep an eye on them. 

In all the chaos that the galaxy is now, the production of new ships is not that active. Therefore, the Sentinels, who actively contact and support the victims, offered Custodian blueprints to the UMC. Especially for mercenaries who are trying to somehow maintain order in the sectors, the AI changed the original design of the ship so that it could be controlled by a person.

When purchasing multiple DLCs, the time for premium licenses is cumulative.

Pilots! An important update has been uploaded to the servers!

[h1]Weapons, Modifiers and Modules[/h1]

‘Wounded Beast’ protocol
[list]
[*] The boost to speed, maneuverability, and energy recovery reduced to 25%
[/list]
Engine Deimos 9-13
[list]
[*] Module ranks changed from 11-13
[/list]
Neuroconnector “WPN-F70” (13-3)
[list]
[*] The maximum effect of the implant is improved to 15%
[*] Effect application increments boosted to 1.5%
[/list]
Ze'Ta Landing platform
[list]
[*] Drone flight speed reduced by 33%
[*] Maximum drone distance reduced by 36.36%
[/list]
Plasma Arc
[list]
[*] Arc length increased by 10%
[/list]
“Kai” fission launcher
[list]
[*] Active range is now 4500 m
[/list]
Covert Ops drone
[list]
[*] Increased module recharge time
[*] Reduced shield transfer efficiency
[/list]
Jump drive, Jump crystals and Warp vortex
[list]
[*] Damage accumulated from jump range reduced
[*] Increased the negative effect of the Emergency Stasis System
[/list]
[h1]Moon race[/h1]
[list]
[*] Now getting the maximum reward for tasks in xenochips is updated for all players at the same time — at 00:00 GMT daily
[/list]
[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug with the negative effect from the Pirate shrapnel cannon applied to all opponents.
[/list]
The update's description reflects the key changes in the game and does not contain a comprehensive list of all changes. Changes aimed at the development of the game world are made regularly and may not require the release of an update.

[h1]New mode “Last man standing”[/h1]

[b]Former imperial sectors
System: Pandora
Location: House of the Rising Sun[/b]

Mercenaries! The Union of Free Legionnaires announces the start of special competitions, designed to form the elite of the surviving legionnaires. The competitions will be held in the Pandora system, known for its anomalous zones. Those who can hold out in the anomaly the longest and remain alive will be included in the top list of Legionnaires of the fringe sectors! [list]
[*] In the battle, each pilot only has to watch his own back.
[*] The player can fly into battle on his ship, selected in the hangar before the start of the fight.
[*] The spawn point is chosen randomly.

[*] The space available for flying gets smaller over time because of the anomaly.
[*] Pilots can find temporary boosts on the map.
[*] Your task is to stay alive as long as possible.

Pilots! UMC announces the start of a large-scale corporate confrontation! In the near future, all corporations will have the opportunity to declare war on other corporations and show who is stronger!

To p﻿articipate in corporation battles, corporations need to provide defence to their pilots. Corporation defence is restored with corporate iridium, and with a zero value of defence, wars become unavailable to the corporation. Also, with zero corporation defence, progress in corporate ranks of pilots stops.   
 ﻿
A declaration of war by another corporation is paid for with corporate iridium. The cost of declaring war is dynamic and depends on the rating of the attacked and attacking corporations, as well as on how long corporations have not participated in wars. 

The declared war ends when the defence of one of the corporations has dropped to zero. A corporation's defence is lost from damage dealt by enemies in any PvP battles, including Open ﻿Space.﻿﻿

Pilots! The head of Ellydium corporation security Arlette Sokal came to us with a new task. You need to complete the PvE mission “Fire Support” in less than five minutes*! The development of Star Conflict continues, so we want to bring to your attention an updated development plan. Please note that this text is informational, and only the major changes are reflected in it. In addition to the implementation of this plan, we constantly fix bugs, make various improvements, changes to combat and economic balance. We develop and critically assess new and existing game features.

 

[b]Development plan[/b]
Please note that this text is informational and may be expanded or modified during development.
 
[h1]In the near future you will see:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Ellydium destroyer “Ze'Ta” for ranks 12-14. New special and active modules, weapons and modifiers

[/list]

[list]
[*] Balance game modes and equipment in the game.
[*] Further work on the improvement and the emergence of new types of weapons and active modules.
[*] Improve the quality of PvP and PvE game modes, based on the feedback and wishes of the players.
[/list]
[h1]The following advanced concepts are being developed at the moment:[/h1]
[list]

[*] An update the “Sector Conquest” mode.

notes.title: Changes to ship crafting resources
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4459272/22c89f95c908e67c484ced69fbecdb3471d85dc0.jpg[/img]

Pilots! In this difficult and dangerous time, the UMC engineers continue to work on optimizing the ship manufacturing processes. Today they have prepared particularly important changes.

[b]Very soon, approximately from November 8, such resources as Neodium, Beryllium and Electrum will be removed from the crafting process. Other existing resources will be used for crafting instead. The unspent resources will remain in your storage and can be sold for credits. We have no plans to introduce new resource types.

The changes will affect the following components:[/b]
[list]
[*] Reinforced destroyer structure
[*] Stabilized destroyer structure
[*] Empire destroyer computing systems
[*] Empire destroyer CPU
[*] Empire destroyer activator
[*] Federation destroyer computing systems
[*] Federation destroyer CPU
[*] Federation destroyer activator
[*] Jericho destroyer computing systems
[*] Jericho destroyer CPU
[*] Jericho destroyer activator
[*] Neodium plate
[*] Impure neodium
[*] Enriched beryllium
[*] Beryllium
[*] Enriched electrum
[*] Electrum
[*] Destroyer exterior structures
[*] Destroyer auxiliary structures
[/list]
[b]These resources will remain active and available for trade in the upcoming two weeks. After that, these resources will be taken out of the game, and components for ship assembly will be revised. [/b]

[b]In the nearest upcoming updates all the blueprints for new ships and other new technologies will not include new resources being introduced. All the production will be held with existing components.[/b]

Sincerely,
Star Conflict Team

notes.title: Future changes in game economy
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4459272/b361e13ecb4d5462f987d326ec69955cf7b4c285.jpg[/img]

Pilots! The UMC begins a global optimization of currency in the fringe sectors and is eager to inform you of the coming changes. The upcoming updates will bring the following:

[b]Faction loyalty vouchers are merged into a single currency “Loyalty vouchers”.[/b] 
[list]
[*]All funds from the six faction accounts will be added up in the merged account, and you can still spend this currency on researching modules, modifiers and weapons. 
[*]The maximum limit on Loyalty Vouchers has not changed. It's currently at 1 million.
[*]Over time, Loyalty Vouchers will be completely withdrawn from the game and replaced by the universal currency of the fringe sectors: Galactic Credits. 
[/list]
[b]The number of Galactic Credits on the pilots' accounts will now also have a limit of 500 million.[/b] 
[list]
[*]In the near future, the value of Credits as a universal currency will increase significantly. They will replace some of the craft components in blueprints, you will be able to use them to buy most modules, modifiers and weapons in the game. 
[*]Credits exceeding the limit will be retained in the accounts. But the resources earned in battles and assignments will be sent to you as a timed in-game message.
[/list]
The excess credits can be exchanged in the game store for unique containers, prepared for the fourth anniversary of the release of Star Conflict. [b]Attention! The containers hold components for most of the ships built from parts and the rarest resources of the fringe sectors![/b] The containers will be available only for a limited time, from Friday evening on September 7 to Monday on September 10! Due to the festive events, the UMC recommends pilots to start topping up their credit fund.

In the upcoming updates, the acquisition of items in the game and their production will become easier and more accessible. Stay tuned!

Progress through the ranks will happen in the form of a story campaign, covering a variety of game modes. notes.title: The updated Matchmaking system
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4459272/99886d8755d5305d2d2b4512f4e5b93cfae644ae.jpg[/img]

Attention, mercenaries! With the 1.5.0f update in Star Conflict, a new type of matchmaking system is available, oriented towards game mastery. This allows us to create balanced battles based on the current global fleet revamp, where each ship regardless of rank now has unique characteristics and equipment. The game now has a lot of new tactical decisions, opportunities for maneuver and choice of the enemy.

The system itself will organize a battle with opponents that match your level of play. To increase your level, effectively complete tasks on the battlefield, work in a team and, of course, win.

Skirmish now has three game types:

Easy: the battles involve rookie pilots
Normal: the battles involve pilots with an average level of skill
Hard: the battles involve pilots with a high level of skill

If your ship is not of the highest rank in combat, additional bonuses are applied it, enhancing survivability and damage of the ship. Bonus strength depends on how close your ship's rank is to the maximum possible rank in combat. This allows the ships of lower ranks to compensate for their weakness in technical characteristics.

The unique ship ‘Object NY18’ is now available for construction only as a premium ship as part of the ‘Star Conflict: Journey - Object NY18’ pack. The pack is available in the official [url=https://store.gaijin.net/storefront.php?category=StarConflict&skin_lang=en]Game store[/url] and on Steam.

This bundle includes:

Unique frigate Object NY18
5000 Galactic Standards!

For the first time a ship of this type was discovered on one of the satellites of the gas giant MOA-2011-BLG-322. The titanic ancient ship was abandoned for millennia. By pure chance, it was discovered by treasure hunters. A working mini-shipyard was found on board, which enabled Ellydium Corporation to quickly launch mass production of similar vessels, but much smaller. These ships were transferred to the UMC for testing.

Galactic Standards are used as a universally recognized monetary unit for the purchase of unique goods and services in the Star Conflict universe. With Galactic Standards your progress in the game will become easier and more comfortable.

If you purchase multiple DLC, bonuses to credits, synergy and loyalty are stacked. Together they give a bigger bonus! Premium license time and Galactic Standards are also stacked!

You save your time and go straight into battle!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4459272/81ede4fd870cb9238ae0717d63ca54c1f477e470.jpg[/img]

The UMC starts a large pre-series check of new equipment. Ships designed at the dawn of the game keep getting the latest unique equipment and capabilities!

We remind you that new modules and weapons can be quickly obtained for xenochips.

Attention! We recommend that you obtain and upgrade the latest equipment as soon as possible! Purchase of experimental modules will be available only during the pre-series test. When the test concludes, the modules will be available during post-battle trophy search and in Open Space mode. We will announce the end of testing separately. Stay tuned!

Upgraded modules and ships will also help pilots get ranks faster in the upcoming new player progress system, which will be launched in the near future. Check out more on our [url=https://forum.star-conflict.com/index.php?/topic/35755-star-conflict-150s/]Forums![/url]

notes.title: Deal of the Day! 50% off Archelon ship components
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4459272/f4c21a5d0bf0a9018d9159517cdda21681904108.jpg[/img]

Pilots!  It's time to improve your fleet strength! The Federation liaison at UMC reports that a new transport convoy has arrived in fringe sectors from inner worlds. It seems that the blockade has been broken. We are expecting even more trade caravans in the fringe sectors soon!

Only today, January 17, we offer a 50% discount on Archelon components! They can be purchased directly from the ship tree.

The idea of creating a guard frigate had been on the minds of Federation engineers for a long time. The best specialists spent days in laboratories and test sites around the clock to find a solution. During research by General Reactors corporation the engineers managed to develop a unique power distribution system for the ship’s shields. However, a new concept called for a fundamentally different design and characteristics of the ship. All the little pieces of the project finally came together when the leading designer of Dry Lab corporation joined the team.

The special offer is valid for a limited time and will end on January 18!

Sincerely,
Star Conflict Team

notes.title: Developer blog: Command Fighter Update
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4459272/0432e8e2493b9f1d27f4dbb84d65b4f97de7d192.jpg[/img]

Pilots, global fleet improvement is approaching the finish line! The ships are designed at the dawn of the game's creation are now equipped with unique hardware and capabilities. We already talked about the Federation gunship Wolf-M, today we will look at a whole role — command fighters.

New modules and weapons will be available immediately when buying a ship. Pilots, who already have ships, will be able to easily get new items on their own: build them or find them in the game.
 
In the future, we will continue talking about fleet updates, engineering and long-range frigates, interceptors and much more. It's easy to see that each reworked spaceship will have interesting and unique gameplay mechanics. It will be possible to verify this very soon, by taking part in our traditional mass testing. 

Check out the details on our [url=https://forum.star-conflict.com/index.php?/topic/35185-developer-blog-from-november-16-command-fighter-update/]Forums![/url]
