notes.title: A Halloween Story!
notes.notes:
[img]http://img.targem.ru/images/a49cb87735f4e32fb411f4e8a08a.png[/img]

Pilots, here's our Halloween story! 

"You want details? All right. I'll tell you everything as it happened. Me and Airut often take jobs just for the two of us. It's not like were best friends forever. But yeah, we spent lots and lots of time in station bars...

We understand each other. Didn't even need comms. Just wave the wing. Your squadmate will understand. Oh well. We were probably the best duo in our sector. Even the military tried recruiting us. We didn't like all the drills, orders and so on. Don't go there. Don't touch these. Ugh.

And then this Imperial security services hag comes along. It was late in the evening on 31 October. Remember that clearly. And she says to us. Guys, you're like so cool, come on, it's not far away. Do it really fast. Just a bit of air. She just had to air something in that system that night. Maybe they saw someone there, or someone disappeared. Never really cared. But the partner listened carefully. Yeah.

You know how this goes. Jobs are hard to come by. Aliens everywhere. Stuff with Cybers. Damn pirates popping up. Refugees in every corridor. Just flying by the sector is pretty dangerous. Could stumble upon a biomorph raid and that's that. A huge Alien ship appeared nearby. Started shooting portals throughout the system. Barely made it, they say. People were killed... Our merc brothers too. And that was, well, easy.

We took the job. It's money after all. Needed just that much more for a new fighter too. Well, you know. The T5 thing. Just the engine's 20% more powerful than mine, and the guns... But, I got carried away.

We went. We had to do it really fast. Right there and then. We went so quietly. Stars pulsing far away. Like they were hinting at something... Going on afterburners to the right gate, cracking jokes through the comms. Waving to fellow mercs. It was all right.

One sector, another. Approaching midnight Imperial time. There's the right sector. Airut moves ahead. I followed him quietly. We always move like that. He's ahead, I'm behind. Covering our own sectors. Each other's back.

Suddenly, no Airuta. Not on the radar. No visual too. Everything still there. He's not. He was there a second ago. Boom, he disappeared. Without a trace. Nothing. I looked around checked the asteroids. Nope. And then I got it. Aliens. It's them for sure. Or Cybers. Or a new military weapon test. I could vanish like that too. I can't even shoot anyone. Basically, I panic.

I only just start panicking, as a sort of portal opens up ahead and there's Airut right before my eyes. The portal promptly closed. I yell at him on the radio and comms - where have you been, what happened. Not a sound in response... And I hear it. he's on the microphone. Breathes heavily. Doesn't say a word. Then rushes at me at full speed. Sixth sense saves me! I can feel it's not him.

Nothing left of my friend. I pull a manoeuvre on full thrust. A precise one. He starts firing. Shield down at once. I managed to get away from the line of sight and limp to the closest asteroid. My finget was on the missile trigger. So, I... hit the target. Right in the ammo box.

And then the portals are out. A lot. Never seen so many at once. Biomorphs come in droves. I huddle between two asteroids. Shut everything off, even the reactor. Feign dead. Stop breathing. I see a colossus drifting past. Never seen anything like that. Couple of kilometers long. And maybe a couple dozen. It was too far. But I won't forget. I'll dream of it at night. Turrets everywhere. Drones and fighters like flies around it.

A few hours past I leave my refuge. System's clear. No one around. Just me. Airut's burned ship drifting close by.

So it goes around here. Men disappear in a blink. What happened to him? I do not know. Do the Aliens brainwash people? Maybe so. Many spread the whispers like that. We feel the bad times come. Scary..." 

Do you have any Star Conflict stories, pilots? Share them with us!

It's time to unite again. Do not give a parsec of our space to the enemies! Aliens, get out of our galaxy! The only good alien is a dead alien!!

notes.title: Panorama: Ilidium Stream
notes.notes:
[img]http://img.targem.ru/images/7986cf12e7c2d4675733651b8b58.png[/img]
The zone ‘Iridium Stream’ keeps many secrets. It holds a massive high-quality Iridium mining operation, which is one of the most important resources in the galaxy, but among the asteroids and mining stations, hide the ruins of ancient civilizations.
Massive shields connected with a strange energy shield were definitely built for protection, and the strange obelisks of unknown material still emit energy. Mysteries held by these ruins attract scientists from all over the galaxy.
Occasional fights for the right to control Iridium deposits between sides of conflict break out from time to time.
Aliens are also very active in the systems. Frequent battles with Alien ships wear out the human forces. The Aliens may be preparing ground for a full-scale invasion of the system. What made them so curious about the ruins? So far, the human fleets are holding the line.

But will it last?
 
Check out an amazing panorama on Star Conflict profile on  [url=http://www.round.me/tour/1907/view] Round.me [/url]

notes.title: Galactic Standards for all your achievements!
notes.notes:
[img]http://img.targem.ru/images/2c0b87d9ddbfc607ef1595f05206.png[/img]

Pilots! Congratulations on successfully repelling the Alien attack. The enemy has retreated, this is our first big victory! In honour of these brave efforts we would like to reward every one of our pilots.

From this point on, all achievements will be rewarded with Galactic Standards. This system will persist in the future. We will pay this new wage for all the achievements you earn in battles and expeditions. 

In addition, in honour of the first victory over the Aliens, Centre decided to further reward all distinguished pilots and issue Galactic Standards not only for the future ones, but also for all the achievements you already got — from the very beginning of the game! 

You will find your prizes for the achievements in the game mail very soon. Please note that this special offer is limited! You'll be able to receive a reward for past services only this weekend. Launch the game often and always check for new messages! 

The enemy is not defeated. It's still cunning and very dangerous. We won the first battle, but the war is not over, so we still need your help. This is just the beginning!

notes.title: Knowledge Day
notes.notes:
[img]http://img.targem.ru/images/e81a9730a80bc3d859bea16a9664.png[/img]
Knowledge Is Power! 
Our scientists need your help, pilots! Last year, during a special operation, codenamed ‘Knowledge Day’, you managed to deliver some very important information. This year, things are much more serious. All of us are in great danger. Once again, we broadcast yhe ‘Knowledge Day’ code signal. While it's active, the Centre will be supplied with all the information about enemies destroyed by you. Analysis of this data will help us understand who or what we're up against in this difficult time for the whole civilization.

notes.title: Ice Belt
notes.notes:
[img]http://img.targem.ru/images/d75e506a7ac1a2fb644009be879c.png[/img]
The Cartel made ​​great efforts to attack the Federation systems. They used a whole fleet of powerful ships led by the flagship dreadnought for their raids.
 
During the invasion, the Aliens attacked the Cartel flagship — it was seriously damaged, yet still retained combat capability. 
 
The Cartel is repairing the dreadnought using all its resources to continue the attack.
 
Since all the Federation fleet forces have been sent to defend the systems from the invasion, it is vital to prevent the Cartel from restoring the dreadnought and using it to continue attacks on our positions.

notes.title: 'International Children's Day' with Star Conflict!
notes.notes:
[img=http://img.targem.ru/images/b7bda9d129b4ae95b11d1d9654b0.jpg]

[h1]Pilots![/h1]

Meet [b]'International Children's Day'[/b] with Star Conflict! Tough pro's will be able to share their wisdom and skill, and new players will learn something new! This weekend our players will be able to get a unique achievement and of course, there will be some interesting offers! 

Experienced mercs will have an opportunity to show new players how 'grown-ups' fight: should you have a pilot in your squad, whose rating is 300 points lower than yours, and win the battle with him, you will get a [b]unique achievement 'Child Defender'.[/b]

Hurry up - you can become 'Child Defender' only [b]until 4 a.m. UTC, June 2nd.[/b]

notes.title: International Day of Human Space Flight!
notes.notes:
[img=http://img.targem.ru/images/110721dd545eb0dfd0513068ad3b.jpg]

[h1]Pilots! [/h1]

Star Conflict Team congratulates you with a very special occasion - [b]International Day of Human Space Flight![/b]

This day is indeed very special to all of us, as on April 12th, 1961 Yuri Gagarin, a soviet citizen, has taken the very first flight around our planet in the spaceship "Vostok". Thus era of manned space flight had opened.

And we are incredibly happy that you are celebrating this day with us! Don't forget - only this weekend you may recieve a unqiue achievement 'Cosomautics Day'!

Sincerely, 
Star Conflict Team.

notes.title: Take part in our cool 'Photochop' contest!
notes.notes:
[h1]Pilots![/h1]

We are launching a creative contest [b]"Photochop"![/b]

Manipulate [url=http://star-conflict.com/upload/image/Events/astronaut.png]this image[/url] using any kind of graphics editing software and publish the result on our [url=https://www.facebook.com/StarConflict]Facebook page[/url] or here, in our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/212070/images/]Group's Album[/url], the original you can find below. All works will be collected in special Facebook’s album.

Humor and high quality will add more points to your picture. Your creativity is only limited by your imagination! What is "Photochop"?
[b][list][*]1st place - 6000 Galactic Standards;
[*]2nd place - 4000 Galactic Standards;
[*]3rd place - 2500 Galactic Standards;[/list][/b]
A special award "People's Choice Award" in 2000 Galactic Standards to the player, whose job will have more "likes" in the album.

Terms:
1. The contest will run until April 8. Winners will be chosen on 10th of April.
2. One participant - one picture.
3. Add the author's nickname, the picture’s name is optional.
4. Picture should be either JPG or PNG.
5. Organizers may ask you for all original materials used. It is forbidden to use other people's work!
6. You automatically pass exclusive rights to the image to organizers of the contest by posting the picture in the thread.
7. Image should be created exclusively for the contest.
8. Image should not break any rules of morale, ethics or law (domestic or international), as well as game rules.
9. Winners are chosen by Star Conflict administration.
The authors of the best works that were not included in the top three will also be rewarded!

[url=http://forum.star-conflict.com/index.php?/topic/22841-contest-%E2%80%98photochop%E2%80%99-discussion/]You can discuss news here![/url]

notes.title: 'Voice Control' Feature!
notes.notes:
[img=http://img.targem.ru/images/82b9f1d8890b3c77dc42fd260833.jpg]

Pilots! As you know, yesterday we have stopped the game servers in order to install a small update! What was in it? Star Gem Games is happy to announce that in continuation of our work over 'Voice Chat' feature we have finished our work on additional feature called 'Voice Control'! This feature was activated yesterday during the update, and you just need to get into the game with any recording device plugged in and try it out yourself!

Here's a short list of commands:

[b]Bots, beacon A/B/C - bots start moving towards one of the designated beacons. 
Bots, protect - one bot in the vicinity starts protecting your ship
Eyes on target - your target lightens up 
Eyes on me - your ship lightens up
Missiles - your ship fires installed missiles
Afterburner - your ship's thrusters start/stop working.
Eject - you are leaving the ship[/b]

You may familiarize yourself with a full list of commands in our game, in menu 'Voice Control'!

Don't forget to use these unique commands: 
[b]- Bots, transform!
- Au revoir! 
- Do the barrell roll![/b]

You can try out the 'Voice Control' feature right now!

Insincerely, 
Star Conflict Team

notes.title: Contest ‘Ancient Nomads’
notes.notes:
[img=http://img.targem.ru/images/148886aa18061513266fc6ffa27c.jpg]

[h1]Pilots![/h1]

Our intelligence beacons just received a distress signal containing distorted information with signatures of unidentified ships. Despite the fact that it was possible to detect the region of space where the data was transmitted from fast enough, capture of unknown ships caused some difficulty — apparently part of the autonomous combat systems were still operational — the pilot who sent the first brief message about this discovery hasn't contacted us since.

Some researchers from our history department suggest that this squad, designation ‘Ancient Nomads’, could have been created before the First War! However, how it got into Precursor sectors remains a mystery.

Right now technological resources of the history department are fully focused on the search for the remaining records in the XXXVI century archives — the researchers think that they hold the Emperor's real name, so the department does not intend to redirect their efforts to anything else. However, as this finding is valuable for Command (during the time of the travel across the expanses of space and Precursor sectors, flight recorders must have collected a huge amount of strategic information), we offer mercenaries to participate in finding signatures of the ships in the archive!

Fleet Command does not want to put their pilots under threat, especially as history department has complete deactivation codes for onboard systems of almost all known types of ships. These codes will be transferred to the ‘Nomads’ using unmanned transmitters. However, it is necessary to know their models.

[h1]You will be given access to the archive that selects a ship model according to different variants of the name! For more information look at the briefing below.

[b][url=http://forum.star-conflict.com/index.php?/topic/22560-contest-%E2%80%98ancient-nomads%E2%80%99/]Briefing[/url][/b][/h1]

notes.title: Годовщина запуска "МКС"!
notes.notes:
[img=http://img.targem.ru/images/1941ffc948d8b246a7fcf9904faf.jpg]

Пилоты!

20 ноября 1998 года на орбиту Земли был запущен первый модуль Международной Космической Станции - «Заря»! Со временем, эта станция стала выполнять функции обсерватории, лаборатории, а затем стала и самым крупным космическим портом! Командование предлагает всем пилотам отметить это важное событие в истории человечества и предоставляет скидки всем пилотам, чтобы те продолжали отважно исследовать глубины секторов Предтеч! В эти выходные вас ожидает следующее:

Бонусы:
  +50% зарабатываемой в бою синергии!

Скидки:
  -40% на все корабли 7 ранга!
  -50% на все корабли 10 ранга!
  -50% на покупку и улучшение модулей Т4-Т5 в кредитах, галактических стандартах и артефактах!
 
Если вы хотите больше узнать об этой станции и ее истории, мы предлагаем вам ознакомиться со следующим [url=http://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%9C%D0%B5%D0%B6%D0%B4%D1%83%D0%BD%D0%B0%D1%80%D0%BE%D0%B4%D0%BD%D0%B0%D1%8F_%D0%BA%D0%BE%D1%81%D0%BC%D0%B8%D1%87%D0%B5%D1%81%D0%BA%D0%B0%D1%8F_%D1%81%D1%82%D0%B0%D0%BD%D1%86%D0%B8%D1%8F]информационным блоком[/url]!

notes.title: 15th anniversary of 'ISS'!
notes.notes:
[img=http://img.targem.ru/images/23bbc29855158ffff1c5d5196651.jpg]

Pilots!

On November 20, 1998 the first module of the International Space Station — “Zarya” was launched to Earth orbit! Over time, this station came to serve as an observatory, a laboratory and then the largest space port! Fleet command offers all pilots to celebrate this important event in the history of mankind, and provides discounts to all pilots so that they can continue to bravely explore the depths of the Precursor sectors! This weekend, you are about to see the following:

Bonuses:
  50 % to synergy gain in combat!

Discounts:
  — 40 % On all rank 7 ships!
  — 50 % On all rank 10 ships!
  — 50 % To purchase and improvement of T4-T5 modules in credits, galactic standards, and artifacts!
 
If you want to learn more about the station and its history, we suggest you read the following [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/International_Space_Station]information block[/url]!

notes.title: Космические скидки!
notes.notes:
[b]Внимание, Пилоты: Космическая Распродажа![/b]

25 лет назад впервые совершил полет корабль "Буран" и в связи с этим Командование объявляет о новых космических бонусах и скидках! "Буран" был одним из самых технологически продвинутых космических кораблей своего времени, в честь этого события, всех наших пилотов ждут скидки на корабли высоких технологических уровней, бонусы к зарабатываемой и выводимой синергии, а также скидки на приобретение трехдневной пилотской лицензии!

Все корабли пилотов получат:

Бонусы:
+50% к зарабатываемой в бою синергии
+100% к выводу синергии

Скидки:
-30% на 3-х дневную Лицензию
-40% на все корабли Т4, включая Премиум-корабли!
-50% на все корабли Т5

notes.notes:
Уважаемые игроки, мы с радостью хотим сообщить вам о начале регистрации на турнир «Лучшие в Космосе»!

notes.title: Список изменений в Обновлении 0.9.7.
notes.notes:
[b]Star Conflict OBT v.0.9.7[/b]

[b]Геймплей[/b]
Настройка сложности миссий PvE: Верфь «Блэквуд», Добывающая станция
Свой бой: теперь возможно создать свою миссию PvE для троих пилотов
Доработана карта Ледяной риф:
[list][*]Изменена геометрия ледяных астероидов[/list]
Оптимизирована производительность
Обучение игре: теперь за успешное прохождение третьего этапа обучения пилоту выплачивается 100 ГС.
Средняя доходность премиум-кораблей повышена на 20%

[b]Ангар[/b]
Теперь окно поиска контрактов может быть свернуто щелчком по свободной области экрана
Верфь
В контекстное меню корабля добавлен пункт "Снять всё"
Теперь в описании орудий отображается величина бонуса критического урона

[b]Оформление[/b]
Стоимость черного и красного цвета при перекрашивании корабля увеличена в 2 раза

[b]Графика[/b]
Переработан эффект выстрела Атакующий дрон
Доработка эффектов взрывов

[b]HUD[/b]
Добавлен центральный элемент
Цвет маркера упреждения изменен на белый

[b]Звук[/b]
Переделан звук "Плазменной дуги"
Доработан звук в Ангаре: теперь меньше низких частот
Доработана озвучка
Добавлен новый музыкальный трек
Доработка громкости звуковых эффектов

[b]Работа над ошибками[/b]
Исправлена ошибка, с исчезновением информации об учебной цели в обучающих боях
Улучшена производительность графики на интегрированных видеокартах Intel, не имеющих поддержки MSAA
Исправлено редкое падение при запуске тренировочного боя
Исправлена ошибка, при которой можно было вылететь в учебный бой на кораблях, находящихся в другом бою
Исправлена ошибка, при которой не засчитывалось выполнение контракта "Крепкая основа"
Исправлена ошибка, при которой была возможность дважды потратить ГС на смену тега корпорации
Теперь тултип Система «Валькирия» отображает затраты энергии на активацию модуля
Теперь, если нажать F11 на экран дополнительно будет выводиться информация о регионе, в котором расположен сервер

[b]Добавлены новые опции:[/b]
"Донаводка прицела": позволяет включить или выключить автоматическое донаведение прицела на маркер упреждения цели
"Учет задержки в упреждении": позволяет включить или выключить учет задержки прохождения пакетов через сеть (лага) при расчете положения маркера упреждения цели
Начальное значение опций соответствует версии 0.9.5

notes.title: Patchnotes for 0.9.7 update.
notes.notes:
[b]Star Conflict OBT v.0.9.7[/b]

[b]Gameplay[/b]
Tuned PvE mission difficulty: “Blackwood”, Processing Rig
Custom battle: you can now create PvE missions for three pilots
Updated Ice Reef battleground:
[list]
[*]Changed ice asteroid geometry[/list]

Optimized performance


Tutorial: successfully completing the third tutorial stage is now rewarded with 100 GS.

Average premium ship profitability increased by 20%

[b]Hangar[/b]
Contract search window can now be collapsed by clicking anywhere outside the window.

[b]Equipment[/b]
Added a new context menu item “Remove all”
Weapon descriptions now display critical damage bonus

[b]Customization[/b]
Black and red colours price increased by 100%.

[b]Graphics[/b]
Improved Attack Drone volley effect
Improved explosion effects

[b]HUD[/b]
Added central element
Prediction marker colour changed to white

[b]Sound[/b]
Revamped “Plasma Arc” sound
Improved Hangar sounds: ambience now has less bass
Improved voiceover
Added new music track
Tuned sound volume

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
Fixed a bug with disappearing target information in tutorials
Improved performance on integrated Intel GPUs without MSAA support
Fixed a rare crash in tutorial battle
Fixed a bug where you could start the tutorial on a ship already in battle
Fixed a bug with the contract “Strong Foundations”
Fixed a bug where you could spend GS to change a corporation tag twice
“Valkyrie” System tooltip now displays energy cost
Pressing F11 now also displays your server region

[b]Added new options:[/b]
“Aim assistance”: toggles automatic aim assistance when looking at target prediction markers
“Ping-aware prediction”: toggles awareness of your network latency while calculating prediction marker position
Default options positions are the same as in version 0.9.5

[b][url=http://forum.star-conflict.com/index.php?/topic/21403-star-conflict-obt-v097-discussion/]Discussion[/url][/b]

Added a new context menu item “Remove all”
Weapon descriptions now display critical damage bonus

[b]Customization[/b]
Black and red colours price increased by 100%.

[b]Graphics[/b]
Improved Attack Drone volley effect
Improved explosion effects

[b]HUD[/b]
Added central element
Prediction marker colour changed to white

[b]Sound[/b]
Revamped “Plasma Arc” sound
Improved Hangar sounds: ambience now has less bass
Improved voiceover
Added new music track
Tuned sound volume

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
Fixed a bug with disappearing target information in tutorials
Improved performance on integrated Intel GPUs without MSAA support
Fixed a rare crash in tutorial battle
Fixed a bug where you could start the tutorial on a ship already in battle
Fixed a bug with the contract “Strong Foundations”
Fixed a bug where you could spend GS to change a corporation tag twice
“Valkyrie” System tooltip now displays energy cost
Pressing F11 now also displays your server region

[b]Added new options:[/b]
“Aim assistance”: toggles automatic aim assistance when looking at target prediction markers
“Ping-aware prediction”: toggles awareness of your network latency while calculating prediction marker position
Default options positions are the same as in version 0.9.5

[b][url=http://forum.star-conflict.com/index.php?/topic/21403-star-conflict-obt-v097-discussion/]Discussion[/url][/b]

notes.title: Фотоконкурс «Поймай НЛО»!
notes.notes:
Пилоты!

Как мы все знаем, нет никаких сомнений в том, что внеземная жизнь существует, и что пришельцы с других планет уже давно живут среди нас. Кое-кто думает, что может скрыть эту истину от нас, но нас не проведешь! Давайте покажем всему миру, что мы знаем правду!

Ждем от вас фотографий на любую из этих тем:

[*]Фотографии НЛО
НЛО в городском небе, у вас на даче, «Батлкрузер» в соседнем дворе?
[*]Пришельцы среди нас
Ваш лучший друг или знакомый, ваш питомец или вы сами сами не с этой планеты? Пришло время сказать правду!
[*]Загадочные объекты на Земле
Вам никогда не казалось, что с виду безобидный и привычный предмет таит в себе нечто загадочное и странное, закинутое из глубин космоса?

Подробности конкурса вы можете найти [url=http://forum.star-conflict.ru/index.php?/topic/36950-%D1%84%D0%BE%D1%82%D0%BE%D0%BA%D0%BE%D0%BD%D0%BA%D1%83%D1%80%D1%81-%D0%BF%D0%BE%D0%B9%D0%BC%D0%B0%D0%B9-%D0%BD%D0%BB%D0%BE]здесь[/url].

Всегда ваша,
Команда Star Conflict.

[img=http://img.targem.ru/images/1462866fb9c2bd111577c43e9948.jpg]

notes.title: Photo contest «Catch the UFO»!
notes.notes:
Pilots! 

As we all know, there is no doubt that extraterrestrial life exists, and that aliens from other planets have been living among us. Some people think that they can hide the truth from us, but we are not fooled! Let's show the world that we know the truth!

We are waiting for your photos on any of these topics:

[List]
[*]UFO photos
UFO in the sky, in your house, «Battlecruiser» in the neighbor's yard?
[*]Aliens Among Us
Your best friend or acquaintance, your pet or you yourself are not from this planet? It's time to tell the truth!
[*]Mysterious objects in the world
You never thought that a seemingly innocuous and familiar subject is hidding something mysterious and strange, that was sent to us from the depths of space?
[/list]

Details of the contest can be found [url=http://forum.star-conflict.com/index.php?/topic/21318-photo-contest-catch-the-ufo/]here.[/url]

Always yours,
Star Conflict team.

[img=http://img.targem.ru/images/e83b5a3b3e6cf736dac491dd3e3d.jpg]

notes.title: "Knowledge Day" Event!
notes.notes:
[img=http://img.targem.ru/images/598b99e71a9d624b380a8ba754cf.jpg]

[h1][b]Pilots![/b][/h1]

Spacefleet command has announced the start of celebrations of the ancient holiday "Knowledge Day"! Young pilots used to start their first test flights exactly on this day! To remind all our veterans of the past, the command has prepared a set of achievements and titles that they will be able to get in battle! Hurry, you can only get these titles for a limited period!

So, here's the list of achievements and the conditions that must be met to obtain them:

[list]
[*][b]Xenobiologist[/b]
[*][b]Underachiever[/b]
[*][b]Bully[/b]
[*][b]Monitor[/b]
[*][b]Instructor[/b]
[*][b]Cosmonerd[/b]
[*][b]Space Cadet[/b]
[*][b]Ensign[/b]
[/list]

[b]Sensei[/b] - is the final title given only the most motivated pilots — you can get it for unlocking all 8 achievements of the "Knowledge Day" event.

[b]Pilots, hurry:[/b] festivities will take place from August 30 to September 6, inclusive, and then getting the achievements and the titles will be impossible! But the ones you manage to unlock will remain forever!
 
After the event, all pilots who have acquired a "Sensei" achievement will also recieve a unique permanent sticker for their ships!
 
Spacefleet command wishes you a Happy holiday and success both in training and in actual combat missions!

Here you can find [url=http://forum.star-conflict.com/index.php?/topic/21159-knowledge-day-event-discussion/]full version of the news[/url]!

notes.title: Праздник "День знаний"!
notes.notes:
[img=http://img.targem.ru/images/db688f78af09096132c1bae241ff.jpg]

[h1][b]Пилоты![/b][/h1]

Командование флота объявляет о подготовке к старинному празднику "День Знаний"! Именно в эти дни юные пилоты отправлялись в свои первые учебные полеты! Чтобы напомнить всем нашим ветеранам о былом, командование подготовило набор достижений и званий, которые они смогут получить в бою! Спешите, получить эти звания можно только в течение ограниченного срока!

Итак вы сможете получить следующие достижения:

[list]
[*][b]Ксенобиолог[/b]
[*][b]Второгодник[/b]
[*][b]Задира[/b]
[*][b]Староста[/b]
[*][b]Инструктор[/b]
[*][b]Космоботан[/b]
[*][b]Кадет[/b]
[*][b]Юнкер[/b]
[/list]

За получение всех этих достижений выдается финальное звание - [b]Сенсей[/b]

Пилоты, поторопитесь: праздничные мероприятия пройдут с 30 августа по 6 сентября включительно, после этого срока получить достижения и звания будет невозможно! Но все полученные за время акции звания останутся навсегда!

Кроме этого, после окончания празднования, все пилоты, заработавшие звание "Сенсей" получат в награду уникальную постоянную наклейку!

Командование поздравляет вас с наступающим праздником и желает успехов как в тренировочных, так и в реальных боевых вылетах!

Тут вы можете [url=http://forum.star-conflict.ru/index.php?/topic/36693-%D0%BF%D1%80%D0%B0%D0%B7%D0%B4%D0%BD%D0%B8%D0%BA-%D0%B4%D0%B5%D0%BD%D1%8C-%D0%B7%D0%BD%D0%B0%D0%BD%D0%B8%D0%B9/]найти полную новость[/url]

notes.title: New Starter Packs Available - Star Conflict
notes.notes:
Three new packs for Star Conflict are now available on Steam!

These three new Pirate Packs will enable new ships, stickers, and premium subscription levels to get you introduced into the pirate brotherhood!

Star Conflict puts players in the role of elite pilots engaging in a widespread interplanetary skirmish. Three thousand years have passed since the first colonists left Earth. Now the galaxy is divided between the militant star empires and independent mercenary groups. In a remote corner of the galaxy — Sector 1337, the area of the dead — a world has been left behind. Here, the ruins of a great civilization of Precursors have recently been discovered. Huge factories and sprawling cities are falling into decay. Fragments of ships lie on the fields where massive battles were once fought. But there is not a living soul. Everything has been destroyed by a mysterious Cataclysm — a pulsing anomaly that burned out all life within this sector.

notes.notes:
Attention, pilots!

Registration for the tournament «Summer Cup 2013» ends on July 18 at 23:59 (UTC+4, Moscow). There is only one week left to sign up for the biggest event of this summer!

Teams, which applied to the tournament via [url=http://challonge.com/SCSC2013 ]Challonge.com Site[/url] and didn't provide a list of participants or didn't complete the tournament registration will be removed from the general list of participants.

Best regards,

notes.title: Летний кубок 2013
notes.notes:
Внимание, пилоты!

Регистрация на турнир «Летний кубок 2013» заканчивается 18 июля в 23:59 по Москве (UTC+4). У вас осталась всего неделя, чтобы принять участие в самом масштабном событии лета!

Команды, подавшие заявку на участие через [url=http://challonge.com/SCSC2013]сайт Challonge.com[/url]  и не предоставившие список участников или не подтвердившие регистрацию в турнире, будут удалены из общего списка участников.

Для регистрации команды, в том числе и повторной, необходимо:

Оставить заявку участника с информацией о команде (название команды, игровой ник лидера команды, игровые ники оставшихся игроков, в том числе и запасных), отправив всю информацию на почту event@star-conflict.com;
Команда будет добавлена в список участников турнира после подтверждения заявки.

Комплекты наград:

8 наборов Пирата — Корсар
8 наборов Пирата — Веселый Роджер
8 наборов Пирата — Сундук мертвеца
24 фирменные футболки Star Conflict

Более подробную информацию вы можете найти на нашем [url=http://forum.star-conflict.ru/index.php?/topic/35725-%D1%80%D0%B5%D0%B3%D0%B8%D1%81%D1%82%D1%80%D0%B0%D1%86%D0%B8%D1%8F-%D1%83%D1%87%D0%B0%D1%81%D1%82%D0%BD%D0%B8%D0%BA%D0%BE%D0%B2-%D0%BD%D0%B0-%D1%82%D1%83%D1%80%D0%BD%D0%B8%D1%80-%D0%BB%D0%B5%D1%82%D0%BD%D0%B8%D0%B9-%D0%BA%D1%83%D0%B1%D0%BE%D0%BA]форуме[/url].

notes.title: Регистрация на турнир «Летний кубок 2013» открыта!
notes.notes:
«Летний кубок 2013» — турнир, который безусловно заслуживает внимания во Вселенной Star Conflict. Этим летом у вас есть уникальная возможность принять участие в самом масштабном событии года, где за призовые места сразятся лучшие наемники космоса! Не упустите свой шанс стать частью этой битвы!

[u]Регистрация продлится до 23:59 (UTC+4 Москва), 14 июля (воскресенье).[/u]

Более подробную информации о турнире вы сможете найти на нашем [url=http://forum.star-conflict.ru/index.php?/topic/35725-%D1%80%D0%B5%D0%B3%D0%B8%D1%81%D1%82%D1%80%D0%B0%D1%86%D0%B8%D1%8F-%D1%83%D1%87%D0%B0%D1%81%D1%82%D0%BD%D0%B8%D0%BA%D0%BE%D0%B2-%D0%BD%D0%B0-%D1%82%D1%83%D1%80%D0%BD%D0%B8%D1%80-%D0%BB%D0%B5%D1%82%D0%BD%D0%B8%D0%B9-%D0%BA%D1%83%D0%B1%D0%BE%D0%BA/]форуме[/url].

Всем удачи!
Команда Star Conflict

notes.title: Пираты!
notes.notes:
Пилоты,

Мы рады сообщить вам о том, что совсем скоро в Star Conflict появятся новые корабли, которые вы сможете попробовать в деле! В нашей игре о необъятных просторах космоса и сражениях на мощных боевых кораблях появляется неотъемлемый элемент многих фантастических рассказов - те, кто с морских просторов перебрались на просторы космоса! Все верно, осталось совсем немного до того момента, когда вам представится возможность взять под управление корабль самого настоящего космического пирата! Ждите новостей по теме в ближайшее время!

Вы можете обсудить новость на [url=http://forum.star-conflict.ru/index.php?/topic/35734-%D0%BF%D0%B8%D1%80%D0%B0%D1%82%D1%8B/]форуме[/url] или на нашей страничке [url=http://vk.com/starconflict]Вконтакте[/url].

С уважением,
Команда Star Conflict

notes.title: Pirates!
notes.notes:
Pilots,

We are happy to inform you that very soon some new ships will appear in Star Conflict, and you will be able to test them out in action! Our game about the vast expanse of space and battles of powerful warships finally adopts an integral part of many science fiction stories — an element that has moved from the sea shores to the endless void of space! That's right, it's almost time for you to take control of actual space pirate ships! Keep your eyes peeled and expect news in the near future!

You can discuss news on our [url=http://forum.star-conflict.com/index.php?/topic/20364-pirates/]forums[/url] or on [url=https://www.facebook.com/StarConflict]Star Conflict Facebook[/url] page!

Sincerely, 
Star Conflict team

notes.title: Star Conflict OBT v 0.8.1 «Training Day»
notes.notes:
Do you want to build your own team? Or maybe battle with your friends? Now you have such an opportunity with the new «Practice» mode. You can create your own custom lobby, assemble a team or join a group of friends!

Fans of adrenaline and intense battles will find a pleasant change in ship dynamics — we have worked on their technical characteristics, increasing the average speed. Now interceptors are even more effective, and new modules allow them to truly shine in the heat of battle. Better, faster, stronger!

The new battleground in the sector 1201 — «Abandoned outpost» is now available for PvP battles.
Activity is increasing among all the enemy groups, and you need to take control of this system by eliminating enemy resistance.

A full list of changes can be found on the [url=http://forum.star-conflict.com/index.php?/topic/19749-star-conflict-obt-v081/] forum[/url].

See you on the battlefield!

Sincerely,
Star Conflict team.

notes.title: Sector Conquest
notes.notes:
Along with the 0.8.0 update come the sector conquests in the Star Conflict universe!
Each sector is divided into 63 locations. At the beginning, each of the sides controls 21 location.
Battles take place on the borders of each side of the conflict's influence zones. You can support a side of the conflict by joining the battle for one of the contested locations on the side of your nation: the Empire, the Federation or Jericho. Success or failure in battle directly affects the degree of control over locations.
You can choose which side of the conflict to represent:

— If you're an independent mercenary, you will be fighting for the side of the conflict represented by your current faction;
— If you are a member of a corporation, you will fight for the side of the conflict in your corporation's jurisdiction.

What exactly is “corporate jurisdiction”?
Starting with the 0.8.0 update, corporation CEOs will have the opportunity to select a jurisdiction — the side of the conflict the corporation supports. Every employee of the corporation is required to fight for the chosen side of the conflict.
Choice of jurisdiction is not mandatory. If the CEO decides to make the corporation independent, all the employees will fight for the side of the conflict represented by their current faction.
 
Sector conquests may include both independent mercenaries and corporations. The corporation that secures the most battles in a contested sector, secures full control over it!

notes.title: The Star’s The Star: Star Conflict
notes.notes:
Can this really be the first game called Star Conflict? The ten seconds of research I applied to the question suggests that it is. Amazing. Anyway, this space combat game from Gaijin is looking interesting. It’s a Russian MMO heading to the west, and it sits roughly along the lines of World Of Tanks or Mechwarrior Online, only this time you’re a space pilot with a big old spaceship full of lasers. So it’s team-based rounds of fighting, with resource-spending and tinkering in the intermissions. The pace of it (at least judging by the gameplay footage I’ve found, some of which you can see below) seems fairly sedate compared to the whizzy zero-G kung fun we’re used to from space games. I understand it’s more of a game of positioning and loadout tactics than reaction time and flight skill, but I can see why that would appeal to a few players. #oldmen
(more…)

notes.title: Star Conflict. An updated development plan is published.
notes.notes:
Star Conflict. A new era begins!

We would like to share with you a new development plan for Star Conflict.
http://star-conflict.ru/en/game/gamedevelopmentplan/

The Star Conflict team would like to thank our players for their interest in the project! Thanks to you, the project is constantly evolving, new updates are being released every week, new content and game modes are in development.
When working on a project, we always consider your wishes and suggestions, and adjust our plans accordingly. Today your opinion is important for us like never before. We hope that you'll like all the great updates that will soon be available to you in Start Conflict.

We will be glad to get any feedback from you on our forum:
http://forum.gaijinent.com/index.php?/topic/18769-game-development-plan/

Sincerely,
Star Conflict team

notes.title: == Star Conflict v 0.7.10 Update # 1 ==
notes.notes:
Game servers will be restarted to apply a hotfix
Expected downtime is about 30 minutes

Here is the list of changes to be made:

Game balance: Battle search, matchmaking
* Carried out improvements to reduce the probability of battle creation failure.

Contracts: General
* Increased the fee for short-term contracts.
- Reduced contract cooldowns. (Not Fixed. Will be implemented in the next update, sorry for disinformation)
* Reputation bonus from the Steam DLC now also increases loyalty gains.

Interface: General
* Returned to the old font.
* Added a space between the player and his message.

notes.title: New Free to Play - Star Conflict
notes.notes:
Star Conflict, a new Free-to-Play action MMO, is now available on Steam!

Star Conflict puts players in the role of elite pilots engaging in a widespread interplanetary skirmish. Three thousand years have passed since the first colonists left Earth. Now the galaxy is divided between the militant star empires and independent mercenary groups. In a remote corner of the galaxy — Sector 1337, the area of the dead — a world has been left behind. Here, the ruins of a great civilization of Precursors have recently been discovered. Huge factories and sprawling cities are falling into decay. Fragments of ships lie on the fields where massive battles were once fought. But there is not a living soul. Everything has been destroyed by a mysterious Cataclysm — a pulsing anomaly that burned out all life within this sector.

You can also check out the Starter packs for Star Conflict to get great bonuses and unique items to propel you into the game!
